_format_note: Content of the Yi King module for Empreinte de l'Ame. Each hexagram has: numero (1-64), nom, nom_chinois, trigramme_haut, trigramme_bas, image, jugement_general, themes (amour/finance/sante/spirituel/famille), traits (6 generic texts used only when the corresponding trait is changing in the reading). Traits indexed 1 (base) to 6 (top).

hexagrammes.image: Heaven's motion is full of power. Thus the noble one makes themselves strong and never falters.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The Creative carries supreme success within it. It is favorable to persevere with uprightness. This hexagram announces a time when energy and initiative are right — but strength is only worthwhile if it stays aligned with the common good.

themes.amour: An energy of conquest and self-assertion. If you're single, this is a favorable time to take the initiative rather than wait. In a couple, be careful not to impose your pace on the other: strength must stay shared, not dominant.
themes.finance: A period favorable to entrepreneurial action and bold decisions. Projects launched now carry the momentum of new beginnings. Avoid, however, the rashness of the last trait (overconfidence), which can lead to overly risky choices.
themes.sante: Vitality and physical strength are here. It's a good time to start a new program or a new bodily discipline. Stay attentive to signs of fatigue: the Creative's power wears itself out if it never rests.
themes.spirituel: A call to fully embody your creative potential, without hiding or apologizing for being strong. Now is the time to dare to be yourself in all your power, with humility.
themes.famille: You may be called to take on a leadership role or a pillar's role within your family circle. This responsibility is legitimate, but be sure to also listen to other family members rather than deciding alone for everyone.

traits.1: Hidden dragon, do not act. The potential exists but isn't yet visible. A time of inner preparation.
traits.2: Dragon appearing in the field. Qualities are beginning to show; seek advice from those more experienced.
traits.3: Vigilance day and night, danger but no error. An unstable position; clear-headedness avoids mistakes.
traits.4: Hesitating over the depths, no error. A legitimate doubt before a decisive leap.
traits.5: Flying dragon in the heavens. The peak, the most favorable moment.
traits.6: Arrogant dragon will have cause to repent. Too much strength, too high: excess turns against itself.

hexagrammes.image: The earth carries everything that exists with a supporting gentleness. Thus the noble one welcomes and carries others with breadth of soul.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The Receptive offers success through gentleness and perseverance. This isn't the moment to force or initiate, but to follow, to welcome, to let things ripen. The quiet strength of patience bears fruit.

themes.amour: A time to welcome rather than conquer. Let the other come to you; the relationship builds through listening more than through initiative.
themes.finance: Caution and patience are recommended. This isn't the time to launch, but to consolidate what already exists and let current projects mature.
themes.sante: A need for rest and regeneration. The body asks to be nourished, not pushed; listen to its rhythms rather than forcing them.
themes.spirituel: An invitation to receptivity and letting go. The wisdom here isn't in action but in welcoming what comes.
themes.famille: A discreet yet essential supporting role. Your stable, welcoming presence carries others, without needing to lead.

traits.1: On the frost, solid ice is coming. Small signs announce great changes; know how to read them early.
traits.2: Straight, square, great: without effort, nothing that isn't favorable. Natural simplicity is enough, without artifice.
traits.3: Hidden beauty, one can remain steadfast. Perhaps in service to a king, without seeking the work for oneself. True worth doesn't need to be shown off.
traits.4: A tied sack: no blame, no praise. Caution and discretion; this isn't the time to expose yourself.
traits.5: Yellow robe, supreme good fortune. The right measure in a modest and sincere position of responsibility.
traits.6: Dragons fighting in the meadow, their blood is black and yellow. When Yin wants to rival Yang all the way, conflict becomes destructive for everyone.

hexagrammes.image: Clouds and thunder: image of initial difficulty. Thus the noble one organizes and structures before acting.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Beginnings are always difficult, like a plant piercing through hard ground. Success is possible but requires not moving forward alone: seeking help and structure rather than forcing ahead in haste.

themes.amour: A budding relationship that needs patience and outside support. Don't stay isolated in the face of early difficulties; surround yourself with caring advice.
themes.finance: A project in a delicate launch phase. The beginnings are chaotic but promising; get organized before speeding up, and accept the help that comes your way.
themes.sante: A period of setting things up, perhaps a new treatment or a new routine that takes time to find its rhythm. Don't get discouraged by the first obstacles.
themes.spirituel: The chaos of beginnings is part of the path. It isn't a failure, it's the very nature of any birth.
themes.famille: A budding or unstable family situation that needs structure and outside support rather than facing it alone.

traits.1: Hesitation to move forward. It's beneficial to remain steadfast, to seek help. Perseverance in initial stillness is wise.
traits.2: Difficulties accumulate, but after a while, union happens. Don't force an alliance; wait for the right moment.
traits.3: Chasing game without a guide, one sinks into the forest. Better to give up than to advance without clear direction.
traits.4: Seeking union is favorable; nothing that isn't beneficial. The time has come to reach out toward an alliance.
traits.5: Difficulty in the favor granted; small perseverance brings luck, great perseverance brings misfortune. Move forward in small steps rather than through grand gestures.
traits.6: Tears of blood flow. A situation blocked to the point of despair; one must accept letting go so that something finally moves.

hexagrammes.image: At the foot of the mountain a spring gushes forth: image of inexperienced youth. Thus the noble one nourishes their character through decisive action.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Inexperience isn't a fault, it's a state to pass through with humility. It isn't for the student to chase after the teacher, but for the teacher to be available when the student sincerely seeks them. True learning requires respect on both sides.

themes.amour: A situation that's still unclear, where you lack experience or clarity. Accept not knowing everything; seek advice rather than moving forward blindly.
themes.finance: A new field where you're still a beginner. Train yourself before investing; the humility to learn is worth more than haste.
themes.sante: A lack of knowledge about your own body or a medical situation. Ask questions, inform yourself sincerely rather than staying in uncertainty.
themes.spirituel: The sincere beginner goes further than the one who already claims to know. Stay open to teaching, without false shame about not knowing.
themes.famille: A learning role, perhaps in the face of a new family situation. Seek the advice of those with more experience than you.

traits.1: To dispel folly, it is beneficial to employ discipline. A clear, firm structure, given with kindness, helps one grow.
traits.2: Bearing folly with kindness brings good fortune. Patience toward others' inexperience, including one's own, is a virtue.
traits.3: Do not marry the woman who sees only the wealthy man: nothing favorable. Beware of superficial or self-interested motives.
traits.4: Folly entangled in its own limits: humiliation. Isolating oneself in ignorance out of pride leads to failure.
traits.5: Childlike folly: good fortune. The sincere innocence of one who humbly acknowledges their own inexperience is protected.
traits.6: Punishing folly; it is not beneficial to commit excesses, it is beneficial to prevent excesses. Correct with measure, never with excessive harshness.

hexagrammes.image: Clouds rise to heaven: image of waiting. Thus the noble one eats, drinks, and rejoices peacefully while waiting for their hour.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The moment hasn't yet come to act. The true strength here is confident patience, not anxious inertia. Nourish yourself, prepare yourself, and the favorable occasion will present itself on its own.

themes.amour: This isn't the time to force a meeting or a decision. Wait with confidence; the right moment will come without needing to rush things.
themes.finance: A project that still needs to ripen before taking shape. Use this time of waiting to prepare yourself rather than to grow impatient.
themes.sante: A healing or improvement that takes time. Take care of yourself while waiting, without excessive anxiety over the slowness of the process.
themes.spirituel: Active patience is a spiritual practice in its own right. Waiting without anguish is already an inner accomplishment.
themes.famille: A family situation that needs to settle on its own. Avoid forcing a reconciliation or a decision before time has done its work.

traits.1: Waiting in the meadow; it's beneficial to persevere in steadiness, no error. Staying far from a danger that's still distant, keeping calm.
traits.2: Waiting on the sand; some slanderous words, but a happy ending. Minor tensions that don't jeopardize the favorable outcome.
traits.3: Waiting in the mud, this draws the enemy near. Getting too close to danger too soon creates avoidable complications.
traits.4: Waiting in blood; getting out of the cave. A perilous situation from which one can still extract oneself with caution.
traits.5: Waiting at the banquet, perseverance brings good fortune. A well-deserved moment of respite at the very heart of uncertainty.
traits.6: One enters the cave; three unexpected guests arrive, treating them with respect ultimately brings good fortune. Unforeseen help changes everything if welcomed well.

hexagrammes.image: Heaven and water move in opposite directions: image of conflict. Thus the noble one, in any undertaking, carefully considers the beginning.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The conflict is real, but engaging in it fully leads to mutual exhaustion. Better to seek mediation than to go all the way to trial or total rupture. Wisdom lies in cutting things short before the situation turns sour.

themes.amour: A tension or disagreement that threatens to turn sour. Seek dialogue and mediation rather than going all the way to rupture or a test of strength.
themes.finance: An ongoing financial dispute or disagreement. An amicable resolution, even an imperfect one, is worth more than a prolonged conflict that exhausts both sides.
themes.sante: An inner conflict, between what the body asks for and what you impose on it. Seek balance rather than confrontation with yourself.
themes.spirituel: Recognizing that you're wrong, even partly, defuses more suffering than being right at all costs.
themes.famille: A family dispute that needs a trusted third party to be resolved. Don't let pride prolong an avoidable conflict.

traits.1: Do not persist in the matter; some slanderous words, happy ending. Stopping a disagreement early prevents it from worsening.
traits.2: Cannot carry on the conflict; he goes home, hides, his community escapes misfortune. Recognizing that one doesn't have the advantage and wisely withdrawing.
traits.3: Nourishing oneself on ancient virtues; perseverance in danger, happy ending. Relying on one's deep values rather than on the position of the moment.
traits.4: Cannot carry on the conflict; he returns and accepts fate, changes and finds peace in perseverance. Accepting to let go of the confrontation to find serenity again.
traits.5: Carrying on the conflict; supreme good fortune. A situation where justice is clearly on one's side and where the clarity of what's right resolves the dispute.
traits.6: One may receive a belt of honor, but it will be torn away three times in a day. A victory won through conflict remains unstable and ends up turning against itself.

hexagrammes.image: In the middle of the earth, water: image of the army. Thus the noble one nourishes their people through generosity and gathers the masses.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: An undertaking that requires organization, collective discipline, and an experienced, respected leader. The strength of numbers only has value when directed with justice and clarity of intention.

themes.amour: A relationship that needs organization and clear direction, perhaps carried by a trusted person who guides it toward harmony.
themes.finance: A project that requires an organized team and clear leadership rather than scattered individual action. Collective discipline bears fruit.
themes.sante: Mobilizing all your resources — medical, personal, relational — in an organized rather than scattered way, under the guidance of a trusted professional.
themes.spirituel: Inner discipline, like that of a well-led army, channels scattered energy toward a single, just goal.
themes.famille: A situation that requires one person to clearly take charge, with everyone's agreement and respect, to avoid confusion.

traits.1: The army must go out in good order; otherwise, whatever its merit, misfortune. Discipline from the very start conditions everything that follows.
traits.2: In the midst of the army; good fortune, no error, the king grants three decorations. A position of trust well earned, recognized by a legitimate authority.
traits.3: The army carries corpses in its carts; misfortune. A badly started undertaking that accumulates needless losses.
traits.4: The army retreats on its flank; no error. Recognizing the moment to retreat strategically, without shame, is wisdom.
traits.5: There is game in the field, it's beneficial to capture it; no error. Entrusting command to one with legitimate authority, not to the youngest without experience.
traits.6: The great sovereign issues orders, founds states, rewards deserving families; small men must not be employed. After victory, reward fairly without giving power to those who don't deserve it.

hexagrammes.image: On the earth, water: image of holding together. Thus the ancient kings established kingdoms and maintained friendly relations with the lords.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Union and mutual support bring good fortune, but only if sincere and coming from the heart. Those who delay joining the movement of fellowship risk being left out of its benefits.

themes.amour: A sincere, deep union presents itself or grows stronger. Mutual sincerity is key; don't delay committing if your heart is in it.
themes.finance: A promising partnership or financial alliance, provided it rests on real trust and not on self-interest alone.
themes.sante: Surrounding yourself with a support network — family, friends, caregivers — rather than facing a health trial alone.
themes.spirituel: Sincere community nourishes the soul more than isolation, even spiritual isolation. Seeking your tribe is an act of wisdom.
themes.famille: A moment favorable to the tightening of family bonds, provided the approach comes from a sincere heart and not from obligation.

traits.1: Sincere and loyal union, no error; sincerity like a full urn, eventually attracts unexpected good fortune. Authentic sincerity naturally attracts what is good.
traits.2: Union that comes from within; perseverance brings good fortune. An alliance founded on deep shared values rather than on opportunism.
traits.3: Union with people who aren't suitable. Choosing your alliances well spares many disillusionments.
traits.4: Union with those outside; perseverance brings good fortune. Opening up to alliances beyond your usual circle can be beneficial.
traits.5: Manifest union: the king only beats the game from three sides, letting the game in front escape; the inhabitants aren't warned; good fortune. True union leaves the freedom to join without constraint.
traits.6: Union without a head; misfortune. An alliance without clear direction or real commitment leads nowhere.

hexagrammes.nom: The Taming Power of the Small
hexagrammes.image: Wind moves across the heavens: image of the taming power of the small. Thus the noble one refines their inner nature.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A gentle, gradual influence, like the wind, prepares the ground without forcing. Great actions aren't yet possible; this is a time for subtle adjustments and patience.

themes.amour: A discreet, gradual influence gently draws two people closer. This isn't yet the time for grand declarations, but for small gestures that count.
themes.finance: Small adjustments bear more fruit than a large-scale action for now. Patience in the details prepares a greater success to come.
themes.sante: Small changes in daily habits, applied with consistency, are worth more than a radical upheaval.
themes.spirituel: Inner transformation often happens through small touches, invisible at first, like the wind that gradually shapes the landscape.
themes.famille: Small attentions and gradual adjustments ease a family tension better than a direct confrontation.

traits.1: Return to your own path, what harm could there be? Good fortune. Returning to your deep values after a detour is always right.
traits.2: Brought back, drawn along by others; good fortune. Drawing inspiration from good examples to get back on the right path.
traits.3: The spokes of the wheel come loose; husband and wife roll their eyes. A tension caused by an imbalance that must be gently corrected.
traits.4: Sincerity; blood goes away, fear disappears, no error. Sincerity defuses a situation that seemed dangerous.
traits.5: Binding sincerity; wealth through the neighbor. The strength of a sincere bond mutually benefits those who share it.
traits.6: Rain falls, rest sets in; accumulated virtue is honored; a woman's perseverance is perilous; the moon is nearly full; the noble one who advances meets misfortune. At the peak of accumulation, caution avoids ruining what has been patiently built.

hexagrammes.image: Heaven above, the lake below: image of treading. Thus the noble one distinguishes high and low and settles the minds of the people.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Treading on the tiger's tail without being bitten: moving forward with tact and courtesy in a delicate situation. Good conduct and respect allow one to pass through danger unharmed.

themes.amour: A delicate situation to navigate with tact and gentleness. Courtesy and respect allow you to move forward even on sensitive ground.
themes.finance: A risky but achievable move if you proceed with caution and good manners. Tact opens doors that force would close.
themes.sante: Moving forward cautiously in a delicate area, respecting the body's limits without forcing them. Restraint protects from danger.
themes.spirituel: Right conduct, even in the face of what intimidates, is a form of quiet courage. Respect defuses the threat.
themes.famille: A tense family situation to approach with delicacy. Good behavior and respect for roles ease what could otherwise explode.

traits.1: Simple treading; move forward without error. Simplicity and modesty allow you to advance without hindrance.
traits.2: Treading a smooth, quiet path; the solitary, steadfast man is fortunate. Discreet constancy brings happiness.
traits.3: A one-eyed man believes he can see, a lame man believes he can walk; he treads on the tiger's tail and it bites him: misfortune. Overestimating your abilities in a dangerous situation leads to failure.
traits.4: Treading on the tiger's tail with fear and caution; good fortune in the end. Attentive caution in danger leads to success.
traits.5: Resolute treading; perseverance, even in danger. Determination, aware of the risk, is sometimes necessary.
traits.6: Observe your path and examine the omens; if all is complete, supreme good fortune. Looking back over your journey to learn from it brings the highest success.

hexagrammes.image: Heaven and earth unite: image of peace. Thus the sovereign divides and completes the course of heaven and earth.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Heaven and earth communicate in harmony: a time of prosperity, flow, and success. Energies circulate freely, the small departs and the great arrives. A blessed period where everything is in accord.

themes.amour: A period of harmony and flowing communication in the relationship. Hearts truly meet; enjoy this precious understanding.
themes.finance: Prosperity and fluidity in business. Circumstances align favorably; it's a good time to thrive, while staying wise.
themes.sante: Balance and harmony restored in the body. A period of well-being where energy flows well; nurture this precious state.
themes.spirituel: The union of heaven and earth within: a moment of deep inner peace where everything seems to be in its right place.
themes.famille: A rare and precious family harmony. Relationships are flowing and warm; savor and nourish this understanding.

traits.1: Pulling up grass brings up the roots tied to it; undertaking something brings good fortune. A good initiative naturally leads to others.
traits.2: Bearing with the uncultivated, crossing the river on foot, not neglecting those far away, not favoring one's companions: thus one finds the middle way. Breadth of spirit and fairness in times of prosperity.
traits.3: No plain without a slope, no going without returning; persevering through difficulty, no error. Every peak contains the seed of decline; keep your constancy.
traits.4: He flutters down, not boasting of his wealth, together with his neighbor, in complete sincerity. Sincere simplicity despite an elevated position.
traits.5: The sovereign gives his daughter in marriage, which brings blessing and supreme good fortune. A noble, sincere union that brings happiness.
traits.6: The wall falls back into the moat; do not use the army; announce your orders in your own city; perseverance, humiliation. At the end of peace, accept decline with dignity rather than struggle in vain.

hexagrammes.image: Heaven and earth do not unite: image of standstill. Thus the noble one withdraws into their inner worth to escape difficulties.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Energies no longer communicate; it's a time of blockage and withdrawal. This isn't the moment to undertake anything or expose yourself. Wisdom lies in withdrawing, preserving your values, and waiting for the course of things to turn around.

themes.amour: A period of blockage or distance in the relationship. Don't force dialogue now; preserve yourself and wait for a more favorable moment.
themes.finance: A phase of standstill where projects don't move forward. This isn't the time to invest or force things; consolidate and be patient.
themes.sante: A period where nothing seems to progress. Don't exhaust yourself trying to force things; preserve your energy while waiting for the situation to unblock.
themes.spirituel: Inner withdrawal in a time of blockage isn't a defeat but a wisdom. Tend your inner garden while waiting for the turnaround.
themes.famille: Temporary lack of communication within the family. Avoid forcing exchanges; respecting the distance sometimes allows harmony to return.

traits.1: Pulling up grass brings up the roots tied together; perseverance brings good fortune and success. Withdrawing with one's own at the start of a standstill is wise.
traits.2: They bear and endure; for small men good fortune, for the great man standstill leads to success. Keeping your inner dignity despite unfavorable circumstances.
traits.3: They bear their shame. Recognizing one's mistakes is the first step toward recovery.
traits.4: One who acts on heaven's order remains without error; their companions share the blessing. The beginning of a favorable turnaround, acting in accord with the moment.
traits.5: The standstill ceases; good fortune for the great man. 'What if this should fail!' He ties things to a cluster of mulberry shoots. Careful vigilance as things improve.
traits.6: The standstill comes to an end; first standstill, then joy. The blockage finally dissolves, giving way to relief.

hexagrammes.image: Heaven together with fire rising toward it: image of fellowship with men. Thus the noble one distinguishes things according to their kinds and families.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Fellowship and community with others bring success, especially if it opens widely rather than closing in on a narrow circle. Sincere union in the open, founded on shared values, allows for great achievements.

themes.amour: A relationship founded on shared values and deep mutual understanding. Openness and sincerity strengthen the bond.
themes.finance: A collective project or an open, transparent partnership. Broad, sincere collaboration goes further than individual self-interest.
themes.sante: The support of a community, a group, on a health journey. Don't stay isolated; fellowship heals too.
themes.spirituel: Belonging to a community of the heart nourishes the soul. Seeking those who share your deep values is a right path.
themes.famille: A spirit of fellowship and openness within the extended family. Bonds grow stronger when they rest on shared values.

traits.1: Fellowship at the gate; no error. An open union without ulterior motives from the very start is healthy.
traits.2: Fellowship within the clan; humiliation. Limiting yourself to your own circle out of exclusivity impoverishes fellowship.
traits.3: Hiding weapons in the thicket, climbing the high hill; for three years he doesn't rise. Hidden mistrust and hostility prevent any true union.
traits.4: He climbs onto his rampart, but cannot attack; good fortune. Giving up a conflict you can't win brings you back toward reconciliation.
traits.5: Men gathered together first weep and moan, then laugh; after great struggles they meet. A true union that finally triumphs over obstacles.
traits.6: Fellowship in the meadow; no regret. A peaceful but still distant fellowship, without regret though without great accomplishment.

hexagrammes.image: Fire high in the heavens: image of great possession. Thus the noble one restrains evil and furthers good, obeying heaven's benevolent will.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A time of abundance and great success, where one possesses much. Radiant clarity attracts prosperity. But true greatness lies in remaining humble and generous at the height of success.

themes.amour: A rich, fulfilled relationship, a time of emotional abundance. Share this fullness generously rather than keeping it for yourself.
themes.finance: A period of prosperity and material success. Enjoy it with wisdom and generosity; shared abundance renews itself.
themes.sante: A time of full vitality and abundant resources. Use this energy to durably build up your well-being.
themes.spirituel: True spiritual wealth radiates and shares itself. At the height of abundance, humility and gratitude are the finest virtues.
themes.famille: A period of abundance and family happiness. Generously share this prosperity and joy with all your loved ones.

traits.1: No dealings with what harms; no error; aware of the difficulty, one remains without error. Staying cautious and upright even in emerging abundance.
traits.2: A great cart to carry the load; one may undertake things, no error. Having solid means to carry great projects.
traits.3: A prince offers it to the son of heaven; a small man could not do so. Putting your resources to the service of something greater than yourself.
traits.4: He distinguishes between himself and his neighbor; no error. Not letting oneself be intoxicated by abundance or compete needlessly.
traits.5: His sincerity is approachable yet dignified; good fortune. A benevolent, sincere authority naturally inspires respect.
traits.6: Heaven blesses him; good fortune, nothing that isn't favorable. At the summit, humility and accord with heaven attract the highest blessing.

hexagrammes.image: In the middle of the earth, a mountain: image of modesty. Thus the noble one reduces what is excessive and increases what is too little, weighing things and restoring balance.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Authentic modesty carries success all the way through. The mountain hidden within the earth: true greatness doesn't show itself off. This is one of the rare hexagrams where every trait is favorable.

themes.amour: Modesty and simplicity of heart attract true love. Don't try to shine; sincere modesty is deeply touching.
themes.finance: Modesty and measure in financial success preserve and grow what you have. Discretion protects.
themes.sante: Humbly accepting your limits and listening to your body without pride fosters lasting balance and true healing.
themes.spirituel: Modesty is the virtue that crowns all others. Making yourself small paradoxically opens the way to the greatest inner elevation.
themes.famille: Modesty in family relationships — knowing how to step back, acknowledging your wrongs — repairs and strengthens bonds more than anything.

traits.1: Modest upon modest; the noble one can thus cross the great waters; good fortune. Double modesty allows the greatest obstacles to be crossed.
traits.2: Modesty that expresses itself; perseverance brings good fortune. A sincere modesty that shines naturally.
traits.3: A deserving and modest noble one carries things through; good fortune. Work accomplished in modesty bears true fruit.
traits.4: Nothing that isn't favorable in manifesting modesty. Acting with modesty in every circumstance is always right.
traits.5: Without boasting of one's wealth to the neighbor; it's beneficial to act with firmness; nothing that isn't favorable. Modesty doesn't exclude firmness when it's needed.
traits.6: Modesty that expresses itself; it's beneficial to set armies marching to chastise one's own city. True modesty begins by correcting oneself before wanting to correct the world.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder bursts out of the earth with a crash: image of enthusiasm. Thus the ancient kings made music to honor merit.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Shared enthusiasm mobilizes energies and carries others along. When the momentum is right and contagious, it's beneficial to set things in motion. But beware the intoxication that makes you lose your sense of measure.

themes.amour: A joyful, contagious momentum animates the relationship. Let yourself be carried by this enthusiasm, while keeping your feet on the ground.
themes.finance: A project carried by a mobilizing momentum that draws others in. Enthusiasm is an asset, provided you stay clear-eyed about realities.
themes.sante: A renewed burst of energy and motivation. Take advantage of this momentum to start good habits, without falling into enthusiastic excess.
themes.spirituel: Enthusiastic joy, when it's right, elevates the soul and carries others along. But beware the exaltation that makes you lose discernment.
themes.famille: A wave of shared joy that brings the family together. Cultivate these moments of collective enthusiasm that bind ties together.

traits.1: Enthusiasm loudly expressed; misfortune. A vain, boastful enthusiasm leads to a fall.
traits.2: Firm as a rock; not a whole day; perseverance brings good fortune. Discerning the right moment without being swept along by collective exaltation.
traits.3: Enthusiasm that looks upward brings regret; hesitation also brings regret. Passively waiting for favors from above leads to regret.
traits.4: Source of enthusiasm; great things accomplished; have no doubt; friends gather. A sincere, confident enthusiasm gathers people and accomplishes great things.
traits.5: Persistently ill, and yet does not die. A persistent constraint that, paradoxically, prevents sinking into excess.
traits.6: Blinded enthusiasm; but if one changes after it's fulfilled, no error. Being blinded by exaltation, but being able to catch oneself in time.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder in the middle of the lake: image of following. Thus the noble one, at nightfall, goes home to rest and unwind.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Following the right movement, adapting to circumstances, brings great success. But to be followed, one must know how to follow what is right oneself. The art of adjusting to the right moment, without rigidity.

themes.amour: Knowing how to adapt to the other and follow the natural flow of the relationship. Flexibility and mutual adjustment create harmony.
themes.finance: Adapting to changing circumstances rather than clinging to a rigid plan. Smart flexibility opens up opportunities.
themes.sante: Following the body's natural rhythms, resting when it asks for it. Flexible listening is worth more than rigid constraint.
themes.spirituel: Following the flow of life with confidence, without forcing. Adjusting to what is sometimes takes more wisdom than resisting.
themes.famille: Knowing how to follow and adapt to the family's changing needs. Flexibility in roles strengthens the harmony of the home.

traits.1: The official changes; perseverance brings good fortune; going out of one's door to mix with others brings meritorious works. Opening up to change and new exchanges is beneficial.
traits.2: Clinging to the little boy makes one lose the strong man. Choosing to follow what's easy makes you miss the essential.
traits.3: Clinging to the strong man makes one lose the little boy; by following, one finds what one seeks; it's beneficial to remain firm and steady. Choosing to follow what has value, even if it means letting go of the superfluous.
traits.4: Following leads to gains; perseverance, misfortune; on the path of sincerity, in clarity, what error could there be? Getting followed out of self-interest is perilous; only sincerity justifies influence.
traits.5: Sincerity in the good; good fortune. Following what is good with a sincere heart brings happiness.
traits.6: Firmly held and bound to it; the king presents it at the western mountain. An attachment so strong and sincere that it becomes consecration.

hexagrammes.nom: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
hexagrammes.image: Wind blows at the foot of the mountain: image of decay to be repaired. Thus the noble one stirs people up and strengthens their spirit.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: What has been spoiled or neglected in the past can be repaired. The present disorder is the fruit of old negligence, but it's precisely the occasion for renewal. Repairing requires courage, method, and a time of reflection before and after acting.

themes.amour: A relationship where old wounds or negligence need to be repaired. The work of healing is possible and carries renewal.
themes.finance: A financial situation deteriorated by past negligence, which it's time to set right with method and determination.
themes.sante: Repairing the consequences of old neglect toward your body. It isn't too late; recovery requires courage and consistency.
themes.spirituel: A work of healing old wounds of the soul. Confronting what has been neglected opens the way to a profound regeneration.
themes.famille: Old family tensions or wounds, often inherited, need repair. This courageous work frees the generations.

traits.1: Repairing what was spoiled by the father; if there's a son, the deceased father remains without error; danger, but a happy end. Repairing the legacy of the past with vigilance leads to good.
traits.2: Repairing what was spoiled by the mother; do not be too firm. Correcting old mistakes with gentleness and tact.
traits.3: Repairing what was spoiled by the father; a little regret, no great error. An excess of zeal in the repair, but without serious consequence.
traits.4: Tolerating what was spoiled by the father; continuing this way meets with humiliation. Turning a blind eye to inherited problems only makes them worse.
traits.5: Repairing what was spoiled by the father; one meets with praise. Setting right an inherited situation with competence earns recognition.
traits.6: He serves neither kings nor princes; he sets higher goals for himself. Withdrawing from worldly affairs to devote oneself to higher values.

hexagrammes.image: The earth above the lake: image of approach. Thus the noble one is inexhaustible in their intent to teach and boundless in their tolerance of others.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Something great is approaching and growing, bringing success. This is a favorable time, but a warning comes with it: this favor won't last forever. Enjoy the good moment while preparing for the change to come.

themes.amour: A happy coming-together, a relationship that grows and deepens. Enjoy this favorable momentum while staying aware that it must be nurtured.
themes.finance: A period of growth and approaching opportunities. Seize them now, for this favorable moment won't last forever.
themes.sante: A gradual, encouraging improvement. Take advantage of this momentum to anchor good habits before the energy fluctuates.
themes.spirituel: A growing spiritual opening, a drawing closer to meaning. Welcome this grace with gratitude, without taking it for granted.
themes.famille: A warm, promising family rapprochement. Cultivate these strengthening bonds, knowing they require ongoing care.

traits.1: Shared approach; perseverance brings good fortune. Moving forward together with others, in steadiness, brings happiness.
traits.2: Shared approach; good fortune, everything is favorable. A shared momentum that meets no obstacle.
traits.3: Comfortable approach; nothing is favorable; but if one is distressed about it, no error. Resting too soon on one's gains, but being able to correct it.
traits.4: Complete approach; no error. A full and sincere openness toward others, without reservation.
traits.5: Wise approach; what suits a great prince; good fortune. Leading wisely by surrounding oneself with the right people.
traits.6: Generous, great-hearted approach; good fortune, no error. Benevolence without calculation, even from one who could withdraw, is blessed.

hexagrammes.image: Wind blows over the earth: image of contemplation. Thus the ancient kings visited the regions, observed the people, and gave teaching.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A time to observe, contemplate, and understand deeply before acting. Stepping back to see the whole picture. Rightly understanding the situation is worth more than rushed action.

themes.amour: A time to observe and understand the relationship deeply before deciding. Step back to see clearly what's at stake.
themes.finance: A period of observation and analysis rather than action. Study the situation as a whole before committing.
themes.sante: Taking the time to observe and understand what the body is expressing, before any decision. Attentive contemplation brings clarity.
themes.spirituel: Deep contemplation is the way here. Observing, meditating, understanding the hidden meaning of things nourishes the soul.
themes.famille: Observing family dynamics with distance and understanding, rather than reacting. Right vision precedes right action.

traits.1: Childlike contemplation; for a small man no error, for a noble one humiliation. A superficial understanding, acceptable in the ignorant but unworthy of the wise.
traits.2: Contemplation through the crack of the door; beneficial for a woman's perseverance. A narrow, partial view of things; sufficient only within a limited setting.
traits.3: Contemplation of one's own life decides whether to advance or retreat. Examining yourself honestly to guide your choices.
traits.4: Contemplation of the kingdom's light; it's beneficial to be the king's guest. Understanding the deep workings of a situation opens the way to an influential role.
traits.5: Contemplation of one's own life; the noble one remains without error. The wise one's lucid self-examination guards against error.
traits.6: Contemplation of their life; the noble one remains without error. Seeing your life from very high above, in its universal scope, with complete serenity.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder and lightning: image of biting through. Thus the ancient kings strengthened the laws through clearly defined punishments.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: An obstacle stands between you and your goal, like something stuck between the teeth. It must be broken through with energy and determination. This is a time when justice and firmness are needed to lift what's blocking.

themes.amour: An obstacle or misunderstanding is blocking the relationship. It must be faced directly and resolved frankly rather than worked around.
themes.finance: A concrete blockage to lift with determination. A firm decision, even a necessary confrontation, unblocks the situation.
themes.sante: A health problem that needs to be dealt with head-on, with decisive action, rather than being ignored or tolerated.
themes.spirituel: An inner obstacle to cut through with courage. Certain liberations require you to bite firmly through what resists.
themes.famille: A family conflict or unspoken tension that's blocking everything. It must be addressed directly and firmly, with fairness, to restore the flow.

traits.1: Feet in the stocks, toes disappear; no error. An early, light correction prevents worse ills.
traits.2: Biting through tender flesh until the nose disappears; no error. A severe but justified punishment in the face of resistance.
traits.3: Biting dried meat and encountering poison; slight humiliation, no error. Facing an old problem tougher than expected, without grave consequence.
traits.4: Biting dried meat on the bone and finding gold; beneficial to be aware of the difficulty and firm; good fortune. Persevering in a difficult task eventually reveals true worth.
traits.5: Biting dried meat and finding gold; perseverance in awareness of danger, no error. Vigilant firmness in resolving a conflict is rewarded.
traits.6: He wears the cangue so that his ears disappear; misfortune. Stubbornly refusing to listen and correct oneself leads to disaster.

hexagrammes.image: Fire at the foot of the mountain illuminates it: image of grace. Thus the noble one puts order into everyday affairs, but doesn't dare settle great questions by the beauty of form alone.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Beauty, form, and grace bring success in small things. Elegance embellishes life, but it must not mask substance or replace it. True beauty serves the true, it doesn't replace it.

themes.amour: A relationship where beauty and refinement of feeling matter. Beautiful and harmonious, it must nonetheless rest on real substance.
themes.finance: Success in the details and presentation, but be careful not to mistake the appearance of prosperity for real solidity.
themes.sante: Taking care of form and appearance contributes to well-being, but don't neglect substance, deep health.
themes.spirituel: Beauty is a path toward the sacred, but it mustn't become an end in itself. Form in service of spirit, never the other way around.
themes.famille: Graceful gestures, beautiful traditions embellish family life. Make sure they express real love, not just a facade.

traits.1: He gives grace to his toes, leaves the carriage and walks on foot. Giving up flashy ease for a more modest but authentic path.
traits.2: He gives grace to his beard. Not confusing ornament with the essential; the decoration follows the substance, it doesn't precede it.
traits.3: Graceful and moist; constant perseverance brings good fortune. Lasting grace comes from sincerity, not from passing sparkle.
traits.4: Grace or simplicity? A white horse comes as if on wings. He is not a bandit, he seeks union. The choice between appearance and true simplicity; authenticity wins out.
traits.5: Grace in the hills and gardens; the roll of silk is small and poor; humiliation, but a happy end. Modest simplicity, at first judged poor, ultimately proves right.
traits.6: Simple, white grace; no error. The highest beauty is that of the natural, stripped of all ornament.

hexagrammes.image: The mountain rests on the earth: image of splitting apart. Thus those above can only secure their position by being generous to those below.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A time of decline and disintegration, where negative forces erode what still holds. This isn't the moment to undertake anything; one must wait patiently for this cycle to end. Wisdom lies in not resisting in vain but preserving the essential.

themes.amour: A relationship that's crumbling or going through a phase of wear. This isn't the time to force things; preserve what can be preserved and wait.
themes.finance: A period of losses or erosion. Don't launch anything new; protect your essential assets and be patient for the cycle to turn.
themes.sante: A phase of weakening where you need to preserve your strength rather than spend it. Take care of yourself and wait for the upturn.
themes.spirituel: Even decline is part of the cycle. Don't fight the inevitable, but preserve the inner seed that will be reborn.
themes.famille: A period of tensions eroding bonds. Preserve the essential with patience rather than trying to fix everything at once.

traits.1: The bed is broken at the foot; those who persist are destroyed; misfortune. The base begins to give way; stubbornness worsens the situation.
traits.2: The bed is broken at the edge; those who persist are destroyed; misfortune. The deterioration progresses; isolation makes one vulnerable.
traits.3: He separates himself from them; no error. Dissociating from a movement of decline, even alone, preserves from fault.
traits.4: The bed is broken down to the skin; misfortune. The danger now touches the quick; the harm is at its peak.
traits.5: A school of fish; favor comes through the ladies of the court; everything is favorable. A turnaround begins; order starts to be restored from below.
traits.6: A great fruit remains uneaten; the noble one receives a carriage, the small man's house is destroyed. The seed of renewal survives decline; the wise one is carried while what must fall, falls.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder within the earth: image of return. Thus the ancient kings closed the passes at the solstice, so that the new force could regenerate in rest.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: After decline comes return: light is reborn, the cycle begins again. This is the turning point, the solstice where day begins to reclaim the night. A time of renewal, still fragile: the new force must be allowed to strengthen gently.

themes.amour: A renewal, a return of harmony or of a person. The flame is reborn, still fragile; nourish it with gentleness and patience.
themes.finance: The beginning of a recovery after a difficult period. The upturn is real but still tender; don't rush it.
themes.sante: The return of energy and health after an ordeal. Convalescence requires letting the new strength be reborn without rushing it.
themes.spirituel: A return to yourself, to the essential, after having strayed. The inner turning point where light begins to grow again.
themes.famille: A renewal of bonds, perhaps a return or a reconciliation. Welcome it with gentleness; what's being reborn is still fragile.

traits.1: Return from a short distance; no need for regret; great good fortune. Correcting a small stray early avoids all regret.
traits.2: Peaceful return; good fortune. Returning to the right path calmly and without resistance brings happiness.
traits.3: Repeated return; danger, but no error. Hesitating and turning back several times is risky but not blameworthy if the intention remains right.
traits.4: Walking in the midst of others, one returns alone. Following your own path even when it differs from the group's.
traits.5: Noble, generous return; no regret. A return to yourself made with greatness of soul and sincerity, without regret.
traits.6: Missed return; misfortune, calamity. Missing the moment of return, persisting in straying, brings serious consequences.

hexagrammes.image: Under heaven, thunder moves: all things receive natural innocence. Thus the ancient kings, rich in virtue and in accord with the times, nourished all beings.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Innocence and natural spontaneity, acting without ulterior motive or calculation, bring success. But innocence demands uprightness: what isn't on the right path brings misfortune. Follow your natural impulse, provided it is pure.

themes.amour: A relationship lived with spontaneity and sincerity, without calculation. Purity of intention is your greatest strength here.
themes.finance: Acting with uprightness and without ulterior motive. Don't try to manipulate circumstances; naturalness and honesty bear fruit.
themes.sante: Trusting the body's natural processes, without anxious interference. Simplicity and naturalness favor healing.
themes.spirituel: Recovered innocence, spontaneous action in accord with what is right, is a state of grace. Acting without calculation, guided by inner uprightness.
themes.famille: Sincere spontaneity in family relationships, without calculation or manipulation. Purity of intention strengthens trust.

traits.1: Innocent action; good fortune. Acting spontaneously from a pure heart brings success.
traits.2: Not counting on the harvest while plowing, nor on the use of land while clearing it; then it's beneficial to undertake things. Acting without obsessing over the result opens the way to true success.
traits.3: Undeserved misfortune of innocence: the cow tied by a passerby becomes his loss, misfortune for the inhabitant. Sometimes misfortune strikes without our being at fault; accepting it is part of life.
traits.4: One who can remain steadfast stays without error. Staying true to your upright nature, without letting yourself be led astray, preserves from error.
traits.5: Illness of innocence: do not use a remedy, joy will return. Some passing ills resolve themselves; there's no need to fuss over them.
traits.6: Innocent action that brings misfortune; nothing is favorable. Even right action, at the wrong time, can cause harm; know also when not to act.

hexagrammes.nom: The Taming Power of the Great
hexagrammes.image: Heaven within the mountain: image of the taming power of the great. Thus the noble one studies the words and deeds of the ancients to strengthen their character.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A great, accumulated, and mastered energy becomes a powerful force. Holding back your power, disciplining it, nourishing it with wisdom, allows great things to be accomplished. This is the time to nourish yourself with wisdom and dare great undertakings.

themes.amour: A relationship rich with powerful potential, which requires mastery and patience to fully blossom. Contained strength prepares great things.
themes.finance: Great resources accumulated, ready to be deployed wisely. The moment approaches to dare great undertakings, with discipline.
themes.sante: A powerful vital energy to channel with discipline. Well-mastered strength, nourished by good habits, builds solid health.
themes.spirituel: Inner strength accumulated through discipline and study becomes a creative power. Nourishing yourself with ancient wisdom fortifies the soul.
themes.famille: A family whose strength lies in accumulated and passed-down values. Relying on this wealth for great shared achievements.

traits.1: There is danger, it's beneficial to stop. Recognizing the moment to hold back your momentum rather than rushing ahead.
traits.2: The axle is removed from the carriage. Accepting a forced stop without frustration; the blockage sometimes protects.
traits.3: A good horse that follows others; beneficial to be aware of danger and firm; practice every day; it's beneficial to undertake things. The momentum is there; vigilance and constant training allow you to go far.
traits.4: The protective board of the young bull; great good fortune. Preventing a danger at its source, before it develops, is very favorable.
traits.5: The tusks of a gelded boar; good fortune. Neutralizing a dangerous force at its root rather than facing it head-on.
traits.6: One reaches the way of heaven; success. Fully mastered strength, released at the right moment, opens the greatest paths.

hexagrammes.image: Under the mountain, thunder: image of nourishment. Thus the noble one is careful with their words and moderate in eating and drinking.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The hexagram of nourishment, in the literal and figurative sense: what one feeds on, body and spirit. Success comes from the attention paid to what one gives and receives as nourishment. Observe what nourishes you and what you nourish.

themes.amour: Observe what truly nourishes the relationship and what impoverishes it. A healthy relationship feeds on right attention and kind words.
themes.finance: Being attentive to what truly feeds your prosperity and what squanders it. Moderation and discernment in spending are key.
themes.sante: Particular attention to nourishment, in the broad sense: what you eat, breathe, and let into yourself. Moderation nourishes health.
themes.spirituel: What do you nourish your soul with? Thoughts, readings, and company are food for the spirit. Choose them with care.
themes.famille: What you nourish the family with — attention, words, values — shapes it. Take care to give a healthy, generous emotional nourishment.

traits.1: You set aside your sacred turtle and watch me, jaws hanging; misfortune. Envying what others have rather than appreciating your own resources impoverishes you.
traits.2: Feeding by turning off the path, addressing the hill to be fed; continuing this way leads to misfortune. Seeking your sustenance in the wrong direction, against your nature, fails.
traits.3: Turning away from nourishment; perseverance, misfortune; do not act this way for ten years; nothing is favorable. Feeding on what doesn't suit you leads to a long derangement.
traits.4: Turning toward the summit to be fed; good fortune; the tiger watches with a piercing gaze, its desire insatiable; no error. Seeking elevated nourishment, with an ardent but rightful desire, is beneficial.
traits.5: Straying from the path; remaining steadfast brings good fortune; one must not cross the great waters. Recognizing your limits and staying in place rather than venturing beyond your strength.
traits.6: The source of nourishment; awareness of danger brings good fortune; it's beneficial to cross the great waters. Becoming yourself a source of nourishment for others, with vigilance, allows for great undertakings.

hexagrammes.image: The lake submerges the trees: image of the preponderance of the great. Thus the noble one, when alone, knows no fear, and if they must renounce the world, they remain without sorrow.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A load too heavy weighs on supports too weak, like a beam bending. The situation is critical and exceptional, requiring extraordinary action. A moment of crisis that demands courage and decisive measures, but also clear-sightedness so as not to collapse.

themes.amour: A relationship under great strain, where the weight of things threatens the balance. A critical moment that calls for courageous, sincere decisions.
themes.finance: A situation of overload where the foundations are fragile. You must act decisively and exceptionally to avoid collapse.
themes.sante: A period where the body or mind is under excessive strain. Don't ignore the signals; lightening the load becomes urgent.
themes.spirituel: A moment of inner crisis where the old collapses. Crossing this extraordinary passage with courage prepares a profound transformation.
themes.famille: A family under exceptional pressure. The moment calls for strong choices and mutual support so as not to give way under the weight.

traits.1: Spreading a mat of white reeds underneath; no error. Great caution and delicacy at the start of a risky undertaking.
traits.2: An old poplar sprouts new roots; an old man marries a young woman; everything is favorable. An unexpected alliance between the old and the new brings new life.
traits.3: The ridgepole bends to the point of breaking; misfortune. Stubbornly refusing to listen, under an excessive load, leads to rupture.
traits.4: The ridgepole is reinforced; good fortune; but other ulterior motives would be humiliating. Reinforcing what is fragile is good, provided it's done without selfish calculation.
traits.5: An old poplar produces flowers; an old woman takes a husband; no error, no praise. A last flourish without true fruitfulness; neither fault nor glory.
traits.6: One must cross the water, it rises above the head; misfortune, but no error. Sacrificing oneself for a just cause, even at extreme peril, is not a fault.

hexagrammes.image: Water flows without interruption and reaches its goal: image of the repeated abyss. Thus the noble one walks in constant virtue and carries on the work of teaching.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Repeated danger, the abyss, like water rushing in. But water teaches: it crosses peril while staying true to its nature, filling each hollow before moving on. In danger, sincerity of heart and constancy allow you to pass through.

themes.amour: A difficult period, a perilous passage in the relationship. The constant sincerity of the heart allows you to cross the ordeal without drowning in it.
themes.finance: A risky situation that must be crossed with constancy and composure. Like water, moving forward methodically without forcing allows you to get past the danger.
themes.sante: A health trial to get through. Constancy, faithfulness to treatment, and inner calm are your best allies in this passage.
themes.spirituel: The abyss is also a place of initiation. Staying true to yourself and sincere at the heart of danger makes the soul grow. Water teaches perseverance.
themes.famille: A deep family ordeal to cross together. The sincerity and constancy of bonds allow you to pass through the danger without sinking.

traits.1: Repeated abyss; one falls into the pit at the bottom of the abyss; misfortune. Letting yourself be caught in the habit of danger, without reacting, sinks you deeper.
traits.2: The abyss is dangerous; one should only seek to obtain small things. In danger, aim modestly rather than risking everything.
traits.3: Forward and backward, abyss upon abyss; in such danger, stop first. Facing peril that repeats itself, it's better to stand still than to agitate.
traits.4: A jug of wine, a bowl of rice besides; earthen vessels simply passed through the window; no error. Simple, direct sincerity creates a true bond even in hardship.
traits.5: The abyss doesn't fill to the brim, it only reaches its level; no error. Not aiming for excess; reaching just what's necessary is enough to get through.
traits.6: Bound with cords, shut in among thorny walls; for three years one doesn't find the way; misfortune. Having locked oneself so deeply into danger that one loses the way out for a long time.

hexagrammes.image: Brightness rises twice: image of fire. Thus the great man perpetuates this brightness and illuminates the four cardinal points.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Fire, light, the clarity that needs a support to shine — like the flame that clings to wood. Success comes from lucidity and attachment to what is right. But clarity requires flexibility and gentleness so as not to consume itself.

themes.amour: A luminous, warm attachment. The relationship shines, but like the flame, it needs a solid support to last without burning out.
themes.finance: Clarity of vision and discernment light up your decisions. Attach your energy to what is solid and right so that it lasts.
themes.sante: Vitality shines forth. Take care to tend the source of this energy, for even the brightest flame needs to be fed to last.
themes.spirituel: The light of consciousness attaches itself to what elevates it. Cultivating inner clarity, with gentleness, illuminates the path.
themes.famille: A luminous warmth radiates in the family. Tend to what nourishes this flame — bonds, rituals — so it shines lastingly.

traits.1: Traces cross one another; if one is serious and respectful, no error. Approaching each day seriously and respectfully from the morning avoids error.
traits.2: Yellow light; supreme good fortune. Balanced clarity, the middle way, brings the greatest happiness.
traits.3: In the light of the setting sun, men either beat their pots and sing, or lament old age; misfortune. Facing inevitable decline, choosing serenity rather than lamentation.
traits.4: Its arrival is sudden; it flares, dies, is cast off. A too-brutal ardor, without support, burns itself out and disappears quickly.
traits.5: Tears flowing, sighs of sadness; good fortune. A sincere, deep emotion that, in expressing itself, ultimately opens the way to happiness.
traits.6: The king uses it to march into battle; it is good to kill the leaders and capture the followers; no error. Using your clarity to cut evil at the root while sparing what can be spared.

hexagrammes.image: The lake on top of the mountain: image of influence. Thus the noble one welcomes others through their inner receptivity.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Mutual attraction, reciprocal influence that unites — like the attraction between a young man and a young woman. Success comes from this sincere meeting where each remains open to the other. A time favorable to unions and exchanges of the heart.

themes.amour: Mutual, sincere attraction is at the heart of this hexagram. A very favorable time for meetings and unions; let your heart open.
themes.finance: A favorable reciprocal influence, an attractive partnership. Exchanges founded on sincere, mutual attraction are promising.
themes.sante: Harmony between body and mind, their mutual influence. Listening to the body's subtle sensations fosters overall well-being.
themes.spirituel: The heart's receptive openness allows the subtle influence of the sacred to touch you. Staying porous to what calls you.
themes.famille: A beautiful circulation of affection and mutual influence within the family. Hearts touch each other; cultivate this reciprocal openness.

traits.1: Influence manifests in the big toe. A beginning of attraction still light, without consequence as long as it stays superficial.
traits.2: Influence manifests in the calves; misfortune; staying still brings good fortune. Wanting to move too fast under impulse; better to wait.
traits.3: Influence manifests in the thighs, clinging to what follows; continuing this way is humiliating. Letting yourself be passively led by your impulses or by others impoverishes you.
traits.4: Perseverance brings good fortune, regret disappears; if you are restless in your comings and goings, only your friends will follow your thoughts. Influencing through the sincere constancy of the heart, not through calculating agitation.
traits.5: Influence manifests in the nape of the neck; no regret. A sincere but somewhat rigid firmness; without great momentum but without regret.
traits.6: Influence manifests in the jaw, cheeks, and tongue. Influence through words alone, superficial, without real commitment of the heart.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder and wind: image of duration. Thus the noble one stands firm and does not change direction.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Duration, constancy through time, perseverance of what lasts. Success comes from faithfulness to a right direction, maintained over time. Not stillness, but a constant and lasting movement, like that of the stars.

themes.amour: The duration and constancy of a settled love. Faithfulness through time, renewal within stability, are the strength of the relationship.
themes.finance: Constant perseverance in a right direction bears fruit over the long term. Regularity is worth more than flashes of brilliance.
themes.sante: Constancy in good habits builds lasting health. It's the regular actions, maintained over time, that count.
themes.spirituel: Perseverance in practice, faithfulness to your path over time, is the key to spiritual deepening. Stay the course.
themes.famille: The stability and constancy of family bonds over time. Lasting faithfulness, ceaselessly renewed, is the foundation of the home.

traits.1: Seeking duration too quickly; perseverance, misfortune; nothing is favorable. Wanting deep stability right away, without building it, fails.
traits.2: Regret disappears. Holding to the right measure allows constancy to establish itself without regret.
traits.3: One who gives no duration to their character meets with shame; perseverance, humiliation. Inconstancy of character, changing moods, leads to humiliation.
traits.4: No game in the field. Persevering where there's nothing to find is vain; constancy must bear on what is fitting.
traits.5: Giving duration to one's character through perseverance; good fortune for a woman, misfortune for a man. Constant faithfulness suits one who must follow, but one who must decide cannot stay fixed.
traits.6: Restlessness as a lasting state; misfortune. Making instability a permanent way of being leads to misfortune.

hexagrammes.image: Under heaven, the mountain: image of retreat. Thus the noble one keeps the vulgar man at a distance, not through anger, but through reserve.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The time to withdraw, to retreat with dignity in the face of rising unfavorable forces. This isn't a flight, but a strategic and dignified withdrawal. Knowing how to retreat at the right moment, without bitterness, preserves your strength for later.

themes.amour: A time when it's better to take distance, to withdraw with dignity from a situation that isn't favorable, rather than force things.
themes.finance: A strategic withdrawal is called for in the face of unfavorable conditions. Withdrawing in time, without bitterness, preserves your resources for the future.
themes.sante: The body calls for withdrawal and rest. Withdrawing from agitation, giving yourself space to recover, is the wisdom here.
themes.spirituel: Inner retreat, withdrawing from the agitated world to recharge, is sometimes necessary. Stepping back to find yourself again.
themes.famille: Taking distance with dignity in the face of a tense family situation. A respectful withdrawal is worth more than a sterile confrontation.

traits.1: At the tail in the retreat; it's dangerous; undertake nothing. Delaying withdrawal puts you in a risky position; stay still then.
traits.2: He holds fast with yellow ox hide; no one can loosen it. A firm, sincere resolve that keeps the right bond even in withdrawal.
traits.3: Retreat hindered by attachments; it's painful and dangerous; keeping servants brings good fortune. A withdrawal complicated by attachments; surrounding yourself with reliable support helps.
traits.4: Voluntary retreat; good fortune for the noble one, downfall for the small man. Knowing how to withdraw by choice, without clinging, distinguishes the wise.
traits.5: Friendly retreat; perseverance brings good fortune. Withdrawing at the right moment, with serenity and kindness, brings happiness.
traits.6: Joyful retreat; everything is favorable. A withdrawal accomplished with lightness and without regret, opening the way to freedom.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder is high in the heavens: image of the power of the great. Thus the noble one does not walk on paths that aren't in keeping with order.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A great power, a vigorous force at its peak. But true strength doesn't lie in brutal display: it resides in restraint and accord with what is right. Power wrongly used turns against itself.

themes.amour: A strong energy animates the relationship. Make sure this power expresses itself with respect and restraint, never becoming domination.
themes.finance: A position of strength and vigor. Use this power with measure and uprightness; brutality or excess would turn it against you.
themes.sante: Great vitality, but one that needs to be channeled. Avoid overexploiting your strength; well-mastered power lasts.
themes.spirituel: True inner strength doesn't impose itself, it masters itself. Power in service of what's right, with restraint, is the mark of the wise.
themes.famille: A strong position of authority in the family. Exercise it with fairness and restraint rather than force, so that it's respected.

traits.1: Power in the toes; continuing this way surely brings misfortune. Wanting to advance by strength alone, from the very start, leads to failure.
traits.2: Perseverance brings good fortune. Strength joined to measure and constancy brings success.
traits.3: The small man uses power, the noble one does not act this way; persisting is dangerous; the goat catches its horns in the hedge. Charging blindly like the ram means getting stuck; the wise refrain from it.
traits.4: Perseverance brings good fortune, regret disappears; the hedge opens, no more entanglement; power in the great axle of the carriage. When strength is applied in the right place, obstacles give way on their own.
traits.5: Losing the goat with ease; no regret. Giving up stubborn impetuousness becomes easy and frees without regret.
traits.6: The goat butting against the hedge can neither retreat nor advance; nothing is favorable; but in the difficulty overcome, fortune arrives. Stuck by your own stubbornness; recognizing the impasse and changing finally unblocks things.

hexagrammes.image: The sun rises above the earth: image of progress. Thus the noble one causes their own bright virtue to shine forth.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Easy, rapid progress, like the sun that rises and shines ever brighter. A time of advancement, recognition, and flourishing. Efforts are rewarded, the ascent is favorable and well received.

themes.amour: A relationship that progresses and flourishes in the open. A favorable time when feelings advance with clarity and mutual recognition.
themes.finance: A period of advancement and recognition. Your efforts are bearing fruit; it's a time favorable to progress and success.
themes.sante: Clear, encouraging progress toward well-being. Energy rises like the sun; take advantage of this upward momentum.
themes.spirituel: A luminous progression along the path. Clarity grows, understanding rises; let your inner virtue shine.
themes.famille: A time of flourishing and recognition within the family. Relationships progress harmoniously, in the open.

traits.1: Progressing, but pushed back; perseverance brings good fortune; if one doesn't meet with trust, remain serene, no error. Advancing serenely even without immediate recognition.
traits.2: Progressing, but in sorrow; perseverance brings good fortune; one receives a great blessing from one's grandmother. After a period of grief, kind and unexpected help arrives.
traits.3: Everyone is in agreement; regret disappears. Advancing with the support and consent of others dispels regrets.
traits.4: Progress like a hamster; perseverance, danger. Advancing through greed and hidden hoarding is perilous.
traits.5: Regret disappears; do not worry about loss or gain; undertaking brings good fortune, everything is favorable. Advancing without clinging to the outcome opens the way to full success.
traits.6: Advancing with horns; only good for chastising one's own city; awareness of danger brings good fortune, no error, but perseverance is humiliating. An aggressive advance, tolerable only to correct oneself, never against others.

hexagrammes.image: The light has sunk into the earth: image of the darkening of the light. Thus the noble one lives among the great crowd; they veil their brightness while keeping their clarity.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A time when the light is hidden, when worth and integrity must conceal themselves in the face of adversity. It's wise to veil your inner clarity, to stay discreet, and to preserve your light rather than expose it to what might extinguish it.

themes.amour: A period when you need to protect your feelings, staying discreet in an unfavorable environment. Preserving your flame without exposing it.
themes.finance: An unfavorable time when it's better to stay discreet about your resources and projects. Protecting your worth rather than exposing it to harm.
themes.sante: A phase where you must protect and preserve yourself, without letting a heavy environment affect you. Keeping your inner light warm.
themes.spirituel: Preserving your inner light in a hostile context, without denying or exposing it. Discretion protects what is precious.
themes.famille: A difficult family climate where you must protect your clarity and inner peace, staying discreet rather than clashing head-on.

traits.1: The darkening in full flight, he lowers his wings; three days without eating; wherever he goes, his host speaks ill of him. Withdrawing with dignity in the face of adversity, even if it means suffering, without justifying yourself.
traits.2: The darkening wounds him in the left thigh; he brings help with the strength of a horse; good fortune. Wounded but able to help others, turning the ordeal into rescue.
traits.3: The darkening during the hunt in the south; the great chief is captured; don't expect perseverance too quickly. Striking at the source of the evil, but without wanting to fix everything at once.
traits.4: He penetrates the left side of the belly, seizes the heart of the darkening, and leaves through the gate and courtyard. Understanding a harmful situation from within, then moving away from it in time.
traits.5: The darkening as with Prince Ji; perseverance is beneficial. Hiding your wisdom under a discreet appearance to survive adversity while keeping your integrity.
traits.6: Not light, but darkness; first he rises to heaven, then he sinks into the earth. One who spreads darkness ends up falling from their own height.

hexagrammes.image: Wind comes out of fire: image of the family. Thus the noble one has substance in their words and duration in their conduct.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The right order within the family, where each holds their place with love and responsibility. Success comes when roles are clear and bonds sincere. What holds true for the family holds true for any human group: harmony is born from the rightness of each.

themes.amour: Harmony founded on clear roles and mutual respect. A relationship where each holds their rightful place with love finds lasting balance.
themes.finance: Good management, like that of a well-run household, brings stability and prosperity. Order and clarity of responsibilities are key.
themes.sante: Well-being is born from an orderly, harmonious living environment. Taking care of your immediate surroundings supports health.
themes.spirituel: Inner harmony reflects right order, where each part of yourself holds its place. Cultivating this inner coherence nourishes the soul.
themes.famille: The very heart of this hexagram: family harmony founded on clear roles, love, and everyone's responsibility. A time favorable to the home.

traits.1: Firmness and restraint within the family; regret disappears. Setting clear boundaries from the start prevents problems.
traits.2: She must not follow her whims, but attend to the food; perseverance brings good fortune. Humbly fulfilling one's nurturing role, without seeking to impose oneself.
traits.3: When one flares up with severity, there's regret, but good fortune; if wife and child laugh and play too much, humiliation follows in the end. A too-harsh firmness is worth more than a laxity without limits.
traits.4: She is the treasure of the house; great good fortune. Whoever truly enriches the home attracts happiness.
traits.5: Like a king he approaches his family; no fear, good fortune. Ruling one's home through love and trust rather than fear.
traits.6: His work inspires respect; good fortune in the end. Sincerity and constancy in tending the home naturally inspire respect.

hexagrammes.image: Fire above, the lake below: image of opposition. Thus the noble one, within general agreement, keeps their individuality.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A time of division, misunderstanding, and disagreement, where beings turn their backs on one another. In small matters, success is still possible. Wisdom lies in not forcing union, but recognizing that even in opposition a hidden complementarity remains.

themes.amour: A time of misunderstandings and disagreements in the relationship. Don't force things; look for small common ground, for opposition often hides a complementarity.
themes.finance: Divergences or blockages in business matters. Move forward on the small achievable things, without trying to resolve everything at once.
themes.sante: An imbalance, a tension between opposing forces within you. Look for small adjustments rather than a great upheaval.
themes.spirituel: Inner contradictions are also part of the path. Welcoming your oppositions, seeing a hidden complementarity in them, brings peace.
themes.famille: Family tensions and misunderstandings. Don't try to force reconciliation; small gestures of openness bring people closer little by little.

traits.1: Regret disappears; if you lose your horse, don't run after it, it will come back on its own; if you see wicked people, guard against error. Don't force the return of what moves away; it comes back naturally.
traits.2: One meets one's master in an alleyway; no error. A chance encounter that restores a lost bond, despite the circumstances.
traits.3: One sees the cart dragged backward, the ox stopped, the man with hair and nose cut off; not a good start, but a good end. Very difficult and humiliating beginnings that, despite everything, end well.
traits.4: Isolated by opposition, one meets a man of like spirit; they exchange in trust; danger, no error. In isolation, finding a kindred spirit who restores trust.
traits.5: Regret disappears; the companion bites through the wrapping; going toward him, what fault could there be? Finding a sincere ally lifts the misunderstanding; moving toward him is right.
traits.6: Isolated by opposition, one sees one's companion as a pig covered in mud, a cart full of demons; first one draws the bow, then one lowers it; it isn't a bandit, he comes to join; as one advances, rain falls and fortune comes. Overcoming illusory suspicion to recognize the friend; the misunderstanding dissolves and union is made.

hexagrammes.image: On the mountain, water: image of obstruction. Thus the noble one turns back toward themselves and shapes their character.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: An obstacle, a difficulty that blocks the path, like water before the mountain. Facing the obstacle, there's no use rushing ahead: better to pause, seek advice, turn back to yourself. Difficulty is also an occasion for inner growth.

themes.amour: An obstacle on the path of the relationship. Rather than forcing your way through, step back, reflect, and possibly seek support.
themes.finance: A difficulty blocking progress. Don't push relentlessly; take a pause, reassess, and seek help or another way.
themes.sante: An obstacle on the road to healing. Don't force things; this pause invites you to turn back to yourself and adjust your approach.
themes.spirituel: The obstacle is an invitation to turn back to yourself, to transform inwardly. External difficulty becomes an occasion for growth.
themes.famille: A family difficulty that seems insurmountable head-on. Pausing, seeking advice, and reconsidering your own attitude opens up ways forward.

traits.1: Going leads to obstruction, coming leads to praise. Facing difficulty, knowing how to step back rather than push forward.
traits.2: The king's servant meets obstacle after obstacle, but it isn't his fault. Facing difficulties out of duty, without being blamed for it.
