traits.3: Going leads to obstruction, so he comes back. Recognizing that moving forward is impossible and returning to what is safe.
traits.4: Going leads to obstruction, coming leads to union. Not facing the difficulty alone, but returning to seek allies.
traits.5: In the midst of the greatest obstruction, friends arrive. At the heart of the greatest trial, decisive support appears.
traits.6: Going leads to obstruction, coming leads to greatness; good fortune; it's beneficial to see the great man. Returning to put your experience of the ordeal at the service of others brings true greatness.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder and rain arise: image of deliverance. Thus the noble one forgives faults and pardons transgressions.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Tension dissolves, the storm bursts and releases: a time of deliverance after difficulty. What was blocked finally unblocks. It's fitting then to quickly return to the ordinary, to forgive, and to settle without delay what needs settling.

themes.amour: A resolution, a release after a period of tension. Forgiveness and a return to simplicity restore harmony; don't dwell on the past.
themes.finance: A blockage that finally unblocks. Take advantage of this release to settle what was lingering and return to a calm, normal management.
themes.sante: Relief, a deliverance after an ordeal. Take advantage of this improvement to find a peaceful rhythm again, without falling back into tension.
themes.spirituel: An inner liberation, the untangling of an old knot. Forgiveness — toward yourself and others — is the key to this deliverance.
themes.famille: A calm after a period of conflict. Forgiveness and a return to simple life heal the wounds; turn the page without dwelling on it.

traits.1: No error. After deliverance, rest; there's no need to act, calm is enough.
traits.2: One kills three foxes in the fields and receives a yellow arrow; perseverance brings good fortune. Casting off misleading influences with uprightness restores balance.
traits.3: One who carries a burden on their back and yet travels by carriage attracts bandits; perseverance, humiliation. Displaying what you've gained, out of your rightful place, attracts trouble.
traits.4: Free yourself of your big toe; then comes the friend you can trust. Freeing yourself from bad attachments opens the way to sincere relationships.
traits.5: Only the noble one can free themselves; good fortune; it proves to small men their seriousness. Freeing yourself inwardly first, which naturally keeps harmful influences away.
traits.6: The prince shoots at a hawk atop a high wall; he hits it; everything is favorable. Eliminating, with one decisive and well-prepared move, the major obstacle that remained.

hexagrammes.image: At the foot of the mountain, the lake: image of decrease. Thus the noble one curbs their anger and restrains their instincts.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Decreasing, reducing, simplifying: sometimes removing is worth more than adding. What seems a loss can be a beneficial purification. Simple sincerity is worth more than rich offerings. A time to be content with little and master your excesses.

themes.amour: A time of simplification, where lightening the relationship of what weighs it down strengthens it. Simple sincerity is worth more than grand displays.
themes.finance: A period of restriction or reduction. Accepting to decrease, to simplify, can be a purification that prepares better financial health.
themes.sante: Reducing, lightening, being content with less — in food, in excess — can be deeply beneficial. Less, but better.
themes.spirituel: Voluntary stripping away, ridding yourself of the superfluous, elevates the soul. Mastering your excesses and passions is a path of purification.
themes.famille: Simplifying, lightening expectations and tensions within the family. Sometimes asking for less and giving more sincerely strengthens bonds.

traits.1: Going quickly when the matter is finished isn't a fault; but think about how much you can decrease others. Helping others promptly, but without depriving them of what they need.
traits.2: It's beneficial to persevere; undertaking brings misfortune; one can increase others without decreasing oneself. Keeping your own integrity while helping; not sacrificing yourself to excess.
traits.3: When three people travel together, their number decreases by one; a man traveling alone finds a companion. The right balance is found in twos; the surplus reduces itself naturally.
traits.4: If one decreases their faults, the other hurries to bring their joy; no error. Reducing your own flaws quickly attracts the help and joy of others.
traits.5: Someone enriches him, ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it; supreme good fortune. A blessing so evident that no doubt can contest it.
traits.6: If he is increased without being decreased, no error; perseverance brings good fortune; it's beneficial to undertake things; one gains servants, but no longer has a separate house. Enriching others without impoverishing yourself: true abundance benefits everyone.

hexagrammes.image: Wind and thunder: image of increase. Thus the noble one, upon seeing good, imitates it; if they have faults, they correct them.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Increase, growth, the time when one gives from above toward below and everything flourishes. A favorable moment for great undertakings and generous actions. What is given generously comes back multiplied. It's beneficial to undertake things.

themes.amour: A time of growth and mutual enrichment in the relationship. Generosity and self-giving make love grow; it's a favorable moment.
themes.finance: A period of growth and favorable opportunities. It's the right time to undertake and invest with generosity and vision.
themes.sante: An increase in vitality and energy. Take advantage of this momentum to strengthen your well-being and cultivate good habits.
themes.spirituel: A time of inner growth, of enrichment of the soul. Giving generously, improving by imitating the good, makes the light grow.
themes.famille: A period of enrichment of family bonds. Generosity, mutual giving, and mutual aid make the harmony of the home flourish.

traits.1: It's beneficial to accomplish great works; supreme good fortune, no error. The favorable momentum allows great things to be undertaken with success.
traits.2: Someone enriches him, ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it; constant perseverance brings good fortune; the king presents him to God; good fortune. An undeniable blessing which, received with constancy and humility, rises to the sacred.
traits.3: One is enriched by unfortunate events; no error if one is sincere and walks the middle way. Even hardship can enrich the one who remains sincere and just.
traits.4: If you walk the middle way and inform the prince, he will follow you; it's beneficial to be used to move the capital. Serving as a fair, trustworthy mediator for great decisions.
traits.5: Sincere kindness of heart; do not question, supreme good fortune; kindness will recognize your kindness. True benevolence, without calculation, is recognized and rewarded.
traits.6: He enriches no one, someone even strikes him; he gives no constancy to his heart; misfortune. Selfishness and inconstancy of heart that gives nothing bring misfortune.

hexagrammes.image: The lake has risen up to heaven: image of breakthrough. Thus the noble one distributes their wealth downward and refrains from resting on their virtue.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A decisive breakthrough, the moment to cut through and resolutely denounce what must be denounced. But resolution must rest on sincerity, not brute force. One must clearly state one's position, without resorting to weapons, with a determination founded on what is right.

themes.amour: The moment to clarify, to say things openly, to resolve an ambiguous situation. Sincere frankness, not brutality, unblocks things.
themes.finance: The moment to make a firm decision, to resolve things decisively. Act with determination, but on fair and transparent grounds.
themes.sante: The moment to resolutely break with a bad habit or to face a problem frankly. A firm, clear decision brings liberation.
themes.spirituel: Cutting through with determination what must be cut through within yourself. The inner breakthrough requires courage and sincerity, not violence against yourself.
themes.famille: The moment to openly clarify a family situation, to speak frankly. Sincere transparency resolves what festers in the unspoken.

traits.1: Powerful in the advancing toes; going forward without being up to it becomes a fault. Launching forward with force without being ready leads to failure.
traits.2: Cry of alarm; arm yourself evening and night; fear nothing. Prudent vigilance wards off danger without needing to panic.
traits.3: Powerful in the cheekbones; misfortune; the noble one is resolute, walks alone, is caught in rain, soiled, people murmur, but no error. Keeping your inner resolve despite appearances and criticism.
traits.4: No skin on the thighs, one walks with difficulty; if one let oneself be led like a sheep, regret would disappear; but one doesn't listen to these words. The stubbornness of advancing alone when one should let oneself be guided.
traits.5: Against the weeds, firm resolve is necessary; walking in the middle, no error. Resolutely eliminating what is harmful, while staying in the right measure.
traits.6: No cry; misfortune comes in the end. Believing the evil eliminated and relaxing your vigilance too soon lets danger return.

hexagrammes.image: Under heaven, wind: image of coming to meet. Thus the prince spreads his orders and makes them known to the four cardinal points.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: An unforeseen encounter, an influence that insinuates itself discreetly. An apparently weak element slips in and could, if unheeded, grow in scope. Caution toward what seduces or insinuates itself: not everything that comes to meet you is good to welcome.

themes.amour: An unexpected encounter, a temptation or an influence that insinuates itself. Stay clear-eyed: not everything that seduces is necessarily good for you.
themes.finance: An opportunity or influence that presents itself discreetly. Examine it with caution; what seems harmless may hide a trap.
themes.sante: A small harmful influence that could take hold if not watched. Stay alert to budding bad habits.
themes.spirituel: A subtle temptation or an influence trying to insinuate itself. Vigilant discernment protects your inner integrity.
themes.famille: An outside influence introducing itself into the family. Welcome it with caution and discernment, without letting in what could divide.

traits.1: It must be restrained with a bronze brake; perseverance brings good fortune; letting it go leads to misfortune. Firmly stopping a budding harmful influence from the start.
traits.2: A fish in the bag; no error; but not favorable for guests. Discreetly containing an influence without letting it spread to others.
traits.3: No skin on the thighs, one walks with difficulty; awareness of danger, no great error. Hesitating, hindered, but caution avoids the worst.
traits.4: No fish in the bag; this brings misfortune. Neglecting or pushing away what should have been kept close creates misfortune.
traits.5: A melon covered with willow leaves; hidden qualities; then it falls from heaven. Discreet, patient virtue eventually receives its reward from above.
traits.6: He comes to meet with horns; humiliation, but no error. A haughty pride that isolates; humiliating, but without great consequence.

hexagrammes.image: The lake above the earth: image of gathering together. Thus the noble one renews their weapons to guard against the unexpected.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Gathering, the reunion of beings and energies around a common center. A time favorable to the union of forces, to great assemblies, to shared causes. But any gathering needs a clear, sincere center so as not to degenerate into confusion.

themes.amour: A time of reunion and deep rapprochement. Hearts gather around a sincere feeling; a moment favorable to commitment.
themes.finance: A moment favorable to gathering resources and forces around a shared project. Union is strength, provided the goal is clear.
themes.sante: Gathering your strength and your circle around your well-being. Don't stay isolated; collective support strengthens you.
themes.spirituel: Gathering around what has meaning, joining a community of the heart. Spiritual union around a sincere center elevates.
themes.famille: A time of reunion and warm, unifying family gathering. These reunions around shared values deeply strengthen bonds.

traits.1: Sincerity that doesn't last; sometimes gathering, sometimes confusion; if you call out, a handshake is enough to find laughter again; don't worry, move forward without error. An initial hesitation that sincerity and a call for help dispel.
traits.2: Letting yourself be drawn brings good fortune, no error; sincerity makes even a small offering worthwhile. Joining the gathering wholeheartedly, with even modest sincerity.
traits.3: Gathering amid sighs; nothing is favorable; going brings no error, slight humiliation. Feeling excluded from the group; seeking union elsewhere, with slight discomfort.
traits.4: Great good fortune, no error. Gathering others in the service of something greater than yourself, without ulterior motive.
traits.5: Gathering around a position; no error; but those not yet sincerely won over... lasting constancy makes regret disappear. Gathering through official position, gradually winning hearts through constancy.
traits.6: Lamentations and sighs, floods of tears; no error. A sincere distress that, in expressing itself, ultimately opens the way to union and is not a fault.

hexagrammes.image: Within the earth wood grows: image of pushing upward. Thus the noble one, with attentive virtue, accumulates the small to arrive at the great and the high.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A gradual, steady ascent, like a tree that grows slowly but surely upward. Success comes from constant effort, without jolts. A time favorable to progressing toward your goals, provided you advance step by step, without rushing.

themes.amour: A relationship that grows gradually, rising gently toward greater depth. Patience and constancy in small steps bear fruit.
themes.finance: A steady, promising progression. Advance step by step toward your goals; constant, patient effort leads to elevation.
themes.sante: A gradual, lasting improvement. Like the tree that grows, your well-being builds patiently, gesture after gesture.
themes.spirituel: A gradual inner elevation. The patient accumulation of small spiritual efforts leads, over time, to a great height of soul.
themes.famille: A harmonious, steady growth of family bonds. Constancy in small attentions gradually elevates the whole family.

traits.1: Pushing upward welcomed with confidence; great good fortune. A start supported by others' trust promises a beautiful ascent.
traits.2: If one is sincere, even a small offering is accepted; no error. Authentic sincerity matters more than the scale of the means.
traits.3: One climbs toward an empty city. An ascent without resistance, almost too easy; move forward without asking false questions.
traits.4: The king introduces him at the sacred mountain; good fortune, no error. Reaching an elevated position in accord with what is sacred and right.
traits.5: Perseverance brings good fortune; one climbs the steps. Progressing steadily, step by step, without skipping stages, brings success.
traits.6: Pushing upward in the dark; it's beneficial to persevere without letting up. At the summit, no longer pushing blindly; it's time for vigilant constancy, not raw ambition.

hexagrammes.image: The lake without water: image of oppression. Thus the noble one stakes their life to follow their will.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Exhaustion, oppression, a time of adversity where energy and resources seem to run dry. But it's precisely in hardship that the true strength of character is revealed. Staying true to yourself and keeping your inner serenity, even without being heard, is here the way of the great man.

themes.amour: A trying period where the relationship seems dried up, where you feel misunderstood. Keeping your dignity and inner faith, without pouring out reproaches.
themes.finance: A time of restriction and lack. The ordeal tests your resilience; stay true to your values and be patient, for this trough will pass.
themes.sante: A period of exhaustion where strength is lacking. Take care of yourself, don't push relentlessly, and keep faith: this difficult phase is temporary. (Sensitive topic: if you're going through a personally difficult time, don't hesitate to talk to a loved one or a professional.)
themes.spirituel: The trial of inner dryness, the crossing of the desert. It's in this stripping away that true faith is forged. Staying faithful without being seen.
themes.famille: A time of trial where support seems absent. Keeping your serenity and dignity, without reproach, preserves the essential until the turnaround.

traits.1: One sits oppressed under a dead tree, sinking into a dark valley; for three years one sees nothing. Letting yourself sink into discouragement prolongs the darkness.
traits.2: Oppressed while eating and drinking; the royal insignia arrive; beneficial to offer a sacrifice; leaving brings misfortune, no error. Even in apparent ease, an inner oppression; sincere patience is eventually recognized.
traits.3: Oppressed by the stone, leaning on thorns; he enters his house and doesn't see his wife; misfortune. Persisting on supports that hurt and neglecting the essential leads to misfortune.
traits.4: He comes very slowly, oppressed in a golden carriage; humiliation, but a happy end. Help that's delayed by material hindrances, but that finally arrives.
traits.5: Nose and feet cut off; oppressed by the man in purple knee-bands; joy comes slowly; it's beneficial to offer sacrifices. A severe ordeal crossed with faith eventually resolves itself little by little.
traits.6: Oppressed by vines, on unstable ground; if one tells oneself that movement brings regret and one repents, then moving forward brings good fortune. Recognizing that you're a prisoner of your own hesitations, finally deciding to move, brings liberation.

hexagrammes.image: Water above wood: image of the well. Thus the noble one encourages the people to work and urges them to help one another.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The well, an inexhaustible source that nourishes all who come to draw from it. Cities change, but the well remains: image of what is essential and permanent. True nourishment, spiritual and material, is always available; one still has to go draw it and tend the source.

themes.amour: A deep, lasting source of love, provided you go draw from it and tend it. What truly nourishes the relationship is permanent and accessible.
themes.finance: The fundamental resources are there, like a well; one still has to make use of them and maintain them. Don't neglect what is your lasting source.
themes.sante: Your deep vitality is an inexhaustible source, provided you draw from it and maintain it. Take care of your fundamentals.
themes.spirituel: The inner source, the well of the soul, is always there, inexhaustible. One must learn to descend into it and draw up its living water.
themes.famille: The family as a shared nourishing well, a permanent resource for all. Tending this source and drawing from it together maintains its richness.

traits.1: One doesn't drink the mud of the well; no animal comes to an old well. What is neglected and left abandoned loses all nourishing value.
traits.2: At the bottom of the well one only catches fish; the jug is broken and leaks. A potential wasted through lack of care and maintenance.
traits.3: The well is cleaned but no one drinks from it; the heart is grieved, for one could draw from it; if the king were clear-sighted, all would receive its benefit. A precious resource restored but ignored; the sadness of good unrecognized.
traits.4: The well is being lined with stone; no error. Taking the time to repair and strengthen the source before benefiting from it.
traits.5: The well has clear, cool water that one drinks. The source is pure and nourishing, offering its benefits to whoever comes to draw from it.
traits.6: One draws from the well without hindrance; in complete sincerity, supreme good fortune. A source accessible to all, without reserve: inexhaustible generosity is the highest fortune.

hexagrammes.image: In the lake there is fire: image of revolution. Thus the noble one puts order into the calendar and clarifies the times and seasons.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Radical change, molting, deep transformation — like skin renewing itself. A necessary upheaval, but one that only succeeds if it comes at the right moment and for just reasons. Trust is only established once the change is accomplished and justified.

themes.amour: A deep transformation of the relationship, a change of cycle. If it comes at the right moment and for good reasons, this molting is liberating.
themes.finance: A radical change is called for or looms ahead. Make sure it comes at the right time and for just reasons before overturning everything.
themes.sante: A deep renewal, a change of lifestyle. The transformation is beneficial if it has matured and is carried out at the right moment.
themes.spirituel: An inner molting, a deep transformation of being. Like the snake that sheds its skin, letting the old die so as to be reborn.
themes.famille: An important change in family dynamics. Well conducted and justified, this renewal can cleanse and regenerate bonds.

traits.1: Wrapped in the hide of a yellow cow. At the beginning, do not act; consolidate your position before any change.
traits.2: When the day comes, then one can make the revolution; undertaking brings good fortune, no error. When the moment is ripe, act resolutely for change.
traits.3: Undertaking brings misfortune; perseverance in danger; when words of change come back three times, one can trust them. Neither haste nor stubbornness; change must be carefully weighed and confirmed.
traits.4: Regret disappears; men have trust; changing the established order brings good fortune. A change founded on sincere trust and the right moment succeeds.
traits.5: The great man changes like the tiger; even before the oracle, he has trust. A transformation so clear and striking that it naturally wins over support.
traits.6: The noble one changes like the panther; the small man just changes his face; undertaking brings misfortune; remaining firm brings good fortune. After the great change, being content with a surface adjustment and stabilizing, without overdoing it.

hexagrammes.image: Above wood, fire: image of the cauldron. Thus the noble one consolidates their destiny by making their position upright.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The sacred cauldron, which transforms raw food into refined nourishment: image of culture, refinement, and spiritual nourishment. A time of great success, favorable to nourishing and elevating, to transforming raw matter into something noble and nourishing.

themes.amour: A relationship that nourishes and elevates, transforms and refines those in it. A favorable time when love becomes a source of mutual growth.
themes.finance: A time favorable to the transformation and refinement of your resources. What is raw can become precious; cultivate and nourish your projects.
themes.sante: Good nourishment, in the noble sense: what transforms and elevates you. A favorable time to refine your way of life.
themes.spirituel: The alchemical cauldron of inner transformation. A time favorable to refining your being, to transforming the raw into spiritual gold.
themes.famille: The family as a nourishing cauldron that transforms and elevates each member. A favorable time to cultivate and refine shared bonds and values.

traits.1: A cauldron with overturned feet; beneficial to remove the bad; one takes a concubine for one's son; no error. Overturning to empty out the old and make room for the good is sometimes necessary at the start.
traits.2: There is food in the cauldron; my companions are envious, but cannot harm me; good fortune. A real wealth that, well guarded, resists the envy of others.
traits.3: The handle of the cauldron is changed, one is hindered in one's progress; the pheasant's fat is not eaten; rain is coming, regret fades, good fortune in the end. A temporarily unused talent that ends up being recognized and employed.
traits.4: The cauldron's feet break, the prince's meal is spilled, his person soiled; misfortune. A responsibility too heavy for fragile supports leads to failure and shame.
traits.5: The cauldron has yellow handles, golden rings; perseverance is beneficial. A fair and solid position, combining inner worth and openness, brings success.
traits.6: The cauldron has jade rings; great good fortune, everything is favorable. The highest success, combining firmness and gentleness, nobility and accessibility.

hexagrammes.image: Repeated thunder: image of shock. Thus the noble one, in fear and trembling, sets their life in order and examines themselves.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Shock, sudden upheaval, like the thunderclap that makes everything tremble. An abrupt event that shakes and awakens. One who keeps their inner calm amid the commotion, who doesn't drop the sacrificial spoon, comes through the ordeal and emerges stronger.

themes.amour: A shock, a sudden event that shakes the relationship. Keeping your inner calm amid the commotion allows you to come out of it more lucid and stronger.
themes.finance: A sudden, unforeseen upheaval. Don't panic; the one who keeps their composure in the shock gets through the jolt without losing everything.
themes.sante: A jolt, an alarm signal from the body that wakes you up. Take it seriously as an invitation to reconsider your balance, without giving in to panic.
themes.spirituel: A salutary shock that awakens and pushes toward self-examination. Keeping inner peace at the heart of upheaval is the mark of a solid soul.
themes.famille: A sudden event that shakes the family. Keeping your calm and your center amid the commotion helps reassure everyone and get through the ordeal together.

traits.1: The shock arrives: oh, oh! then laughing words: ha, ha! good fortune. The initial fright followed by relief; the ordeal ultimately brings joy and caution.
traits.2: The shock comes with danger; one loses great possessions and must climb nine hills; don't chase after them, in seven days they'll be found again. Facing a sudden loss, don't insist on pursuing it; what is right returns in its own time.
traits.3: The shock leaves one stunned; if the shock pushes one to act, no misfortune. Letting yourself be shaken to the point of finally acting helps avoid the worst.
traits.4: The shock gets stuck in the mud. Letting yourself be paralyzed and mired by the shock, unable to react.
traits.5: The shock comes and goes, danger; but nothing is lost, there are things to do. Repeated jolts, but by keeping your center, you preserve the essential and stay the course.
traits.6: The shock brings ruin and a terrified look; undertaking brings misfortune; if the shock reaches the neighbor and not oneself, no error; those close by murmur. Staying lucid when the shock strikes around you, learning the lesson before being struck yourself.

hexagrammes.image: Mountains, one upon the other: image of stillness. Thus the noble one does not let their thoughts go beyond their situation.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Stopping, resting, stillness — like the stable, silent mountain. A time to stop, to become calm inside, to meditate. Knowing how to stop at the right moment, calming the agitation of the mind, finding rest of the heart. True rest is born of inner quiet.

themes.amour: A time of pause and stepping back in the relationship. Calm and stillness allow you to find serenity again and see clearly, without agitation.
themes.finance: A time to pause and consolidate rather than act. Knowing how to stand still, not rushing anything, letting things rest, is wise here.
themes.sante: The rest, the stopping, the calm that body and mind need. Meditation and stillness regenerate deeply.
themes.spirituel: Meditative quiet, the stillness of the inner mountain. Knowing how to stop the flow of thoughts to find the deep peace of the heart.
themes.famille: A time of calm and peace at home. Letting tensions rest, cultivating tranquility, allows harmony to restore itself on its own.

traits.1: Keeping the toes still; no error; beneficial to persevere constantly. Stopping right at the very start, before committing, preserves from error.
traits.2: Keeping the calves still; he cannot save the one he follows; his heart is not content. Having to stop when one would want to help another; frustration but necessity.
traits.3: Keeping the loins still, stiffening the back; danger, the heart suffocates. A forced, rigid stillness, against nature, creates painful tension.
traits.4: Keeping the trunk still; no error. Achieving mastery and rest of one's whole being, in serenity.
traits.5: Keeping the jaws still; words have order, regret disappears. Mastering your words, saying only what is right, dispels regrets.
traits.6: Generous and accomplished stillness; good fortune. Perfect rest, inner peace fully attained, brings happiness.

hexagrammes.image: On the mountain, a tree: image of gradual development. Thus the noble one abides in virtue and wisdom to improve the ways of the world.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Slow, gradual development, like the tree that grows on the mountain or the steady flight of wild geese. True, lasting progress happens by stages, without skipping steps. It's especially favorable to unions and commitments built to last.

themes.amour: A relationship that builds gradually, step by step, over time. This is a very favorable time for well-matured, solid commitments.
themes.finance: Slow but sure growth. Lasting success builds through patient stages; resist the temptation of shortcuts.
themes.sante: A gradual, solid improvement. Lasting health progress happens step by step, in patience and constancy.
themes.spirituel: The spiritual path unfolds in gradual stages, without haste. Each level prepares the next; honor the natural rhythm of growth.
themes.famille: Family bonds develop and strengthen gradually. Patient, step-by-step construction creates lasting harmony.

traits.1: Wild geese gradually approach the shore; the young is in danger, people murmur, no error. Cautious beginnings exposed to criticism, but no real fault.
traits.2: The geese gradually approach the rock; they eat and drink in peace; good fortune. Reaching a safe place and sharing tranquility with your own.
traits.3: The geese gradually approach the plateau; the man leaves and doesn't return, the woman conceives but doesn't raise the child; misfortune; beneficial to repel bandits. Venturing too far too fast breaks the harmony; you must protect yourself.
traits.4: The geese gradually approach the tree; perhaps they find a flat branch; no error. Finding a temporary but safe support in an uncomfortable position.
traits.5: The geese gradually approach the summit; for three years the woman has no child, but in the end nothing can prevent it; good fortune. Despite prolonged obstacles and misunderstandings, the right union ends up being fulfilled.
traits.6: The geese gradually approach the heights of heaven; their feathers can be used for the sacred dance; good fortune. The highest accomplishment, whose example becomes an inspiration to all.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder above the lake: image of the marrying maiden. Thus the noble one understands the transient in the light of the eternal end.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: A union or a situation where one occupies a subordinate, dependent, or irregular position. Undertaking things in this spirit can bring misfortune. This is a reminder to stay clear-eyed: to understand your true place in a relationship, not to indulge in illusions, and to see beyond the transient.

themes.amour: A relationship where your position may be unbalanced or dependent. Stay clear-eyed about the real dynamics, without indulging in illusions.
themes.finance: A subordinate or irregular situation. Don't commit blindly; understand your true position before acting, without illusions.
themes.sante: Lucidly accepting a transient situation, without expecting more from it than it can give. Clear-sightedness about your limits protects you.
themes.spirituel: Understanding the transient in the light of the eternal. Seeing beyond the appearances of a situation, accepting your rightful place with wisdom.
themes.famille: An unbalanced or delicate family dynamic. Clear-sightedness about the real roles, without illusion or idealization, helps you find the right attitude.

traits.1: The marrying maiden as a companion; the lame can walk; undertaking brings good fortune. Humbly accepting a modest position and doing it well brings happiness.
traits.2: The one-eyed can see; beneficial for the perseverance of a solitary man. Staying faithful and steady even in a limited or disappointing situation.
traits.3: The marrying maiden as a servant; she marries as a concubine. Accepting an unworthy position out of impatience; better to wait for a fairer place.
traits.4: The marrying maiden goes past the term; a late marriage comes in its own time. Not rushing; waiting for the right union, even if it's delayed, is wise.
traits.5: The sovereign gives his daughter in marriage; the princess's adornments are not as beautiful as those of her attendant; the moon nearly full; good fortune. True inner nobility surpasses finery; sincere modesty is the finest adornment.
traits.6: The woman holds the basket, but there's no fruit in it; the man cuts the sheep, but there's no blood; nothing is favorable. A union or commitment empty of real substance leads nowhere.

hexagrammes.image: Thunder and lightning arrive together: image of abundance. Thus the noble one settles lawsuits and carries out punishments.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Abundance, fullness, the culminating point where everything is at its peak. A time of great wealth and radiance, like the sun at noon. But the peak already contains decline: one must know how to enjoy this fullness without sadness, while knowing it's fleeting.

themes.amour: A time of fullness and emotional abundance, a peak in the relationship. Savor this moment of radiance fully without anxiety about the future.
themes.finance: A period of abundance and success at its height. Enjoy it wisely, while knowing that every peak one day calls for an adjustment.
themes.sante: Full vitality, a peak of energy. Enjoy this fullness while maintaining it, for the cycles of life are ever-moving.
themes.spirituel: A moment of fullness and inner illumination. Living this peak fully with gratitude, without clinging to it, for everything is movement.
themes.famille: A time of family happiness at its height, an abundance of shared joy. Savor these precious moments without tarnishing them with worry.

traits.1: One meets the master who suits us; though it's between equals, no error; going has value. A meeting between equals at the start of abundance, a source of fulfillment.
traits.2: The abundance is so great that the bushel veils the sun at noon; if one advances, one meets with suspicion and hatred; sincerity opens it; good fortune. When darkness veils clarity, inner sincerity eventually shines through.
traits.3: The abundance is such that light rain veils the sun; one sees the small stars at noon; the right arm breaks; no error. An occultation so complete that one is paralyzed; not a fault, but a time of powerlessness.
traits.4: The abundance is so great that the bushel veils the sun at noon; one meets the master who resembles us; good fortune. After the darkness, finding again a soul who shares their light brings back happiness.
traits.5: Lines come, blessing and glory arrive; good fortune. Surrounding yourself with people of worth and listening to wise counsel attracts recognition.
traits.6: His house is in abundance, but he shuts his family away; he looks through the door, all is quiet, no one there; for three years he sees no one; misfortune. Isolating yourself proudly in your abundance leads to solitude and decline.

hexagrammes.image: Fire on the mountain: image of the wanderer. Thus the noble one is clear and cautious in applying punishments and doesn't let lawsuits drag on.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The wanderer, the stranger passing through, who is at home nowhere and must move forward with caution and reserve. In small matters, success is possible. The wisdom of the wanderer is to stay modest, courteous, not to become attached, and to keep their inner dignity far from their usual bearings.

themes.amour: A situation of passage, a transient relationship or one far from your usual bearings. Move forward with caution and without becoming attached too quickly.
themes.finance: An unstable or transitional situation, outside your usual ground. Stay cautious and modest; don't commit as if you were on familiar territory.
themes.sante: A period of transition, of displacement, outside your usual bearings. Take care of yourself with caution in this shifting context.
themes.spirituel: The inner wanderer, the soul passing through on earth. Cultivating detachment, modesty, and inner dignity far from any anchor.
themes.famille: A situation where you feel like you're passing through or a stranger, perhaps far from your loved ones. Keep your dignity and courtesy while seeking secure support.

traits.1: If the wanderer occupies himself with petty trifles, he draws misfortune upon himself. Losing yourself in petty concerns degrades the wanderer's position.
traits.2: The wanderer arrives at an inn, he has his belongings with him, he wins the loyalty of a young servant. Finding shelter, keeping your resources, and gaining a faithful support.
traits.3: The wanderer's inn burns down, he loses his servant's loyalty; perseverance, danger. Carelessness or harshness costs one their refuge and their support.
traits.4: The wanderer finds shelter, his belongings and an axe; but his heart isn't content. Finding what's needed to survive and defend oneself, without yet feeling at home.
traits.5: He shoots down a pheasant; an arrow is lost, but ultimately this brings praise and a position. An effort that first seems wasted eventually brings recognition and honor.
traits.6: The bird burns its nest; the wanderer laughs first, then moans and cries; he loses his cow carelessly; misfortune. The wanderer's carelessness and arrogance, neglecting their shelter, lead to loss.

hexagrammes.image: Winds that follow one another: image of gentle penetration. Thus the noble one spreads their orders and has their affairs carried out.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Gentle penetration, subtle and persistent influence, like the wind that penetrates everywhere without violence. Success comes not through force, but through a gentle, constant, discreet action that ends up permeating everything. Constancy in gentleness is more powerful than constraint.

themes.amour: A gentle, persistent influence draws hearts closer. Constant, discreet tenderness penetrates more deeply than grand gestures.
themes.finance: Success through gentle, constant, persistent action rather than force. Patient, discreet influence eventually bears fruit.
themes.sante: Gentle, gradual changes, applied with constancy, transform lastingly. Subtle regularity is worth more than brutal efforts.
themes.spirituel: The subtle influence of the breath, the gentle penetration of wisdom. Inner transformation happens through patient permeation, not force.
themes.famille: A gentle, persistent influence soothes and harmonizes the family. Acting with constancy and delicacy penetrates hearts more surely than authority.

traits.1: Advancing and retreating; beneficial the perseverance of a warrior. Excessive hesitation calls for firm, disciplined resolve.
traits.2: Penetration under the bed; priests and magicians are employed in great numbers; good fortune, no error. Flushing out hidden influences with the help needed, without excess.
traits.3: Repeated penetration; humiliation. Endlessly reflecting without ever deciding becomes sterile and humiliating.
traits.4: Regret disappears; in the hunt one catches three kinds of game. A right, well-conducted action brings a triple success without regret.
traits.5: Perseverance brings good fortune, regret disappears; nothing that isn't favorable; not a good beginning, but a good end; three days before the change, three days after the change; good fortune. A well-prepared, well-followed change, despite difficult beginnings, succeeds.
traits.6: Penetration under the bed; he loses his belongings and his axe; perseverance, misfortune. Pushing investigation or submission too far causes one to lose one's means and strength.

hexagrammes.image: Lakes resting one upon the other: image of the joyous. Thus the noble one gathers with friends to discuss and practice together.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Joy, contentment, happy exchange — like two lakes that nourish each other. True joy comes from within and is shared. It brings success when accompanied by inner firmness and sincerity. Joy shared with uprightness makes you strong and encourages you to overcome difficulties.

themes.amour: A time of shared joy and happy exchanges in the relationship. Sincere gaiety and complicity deeply nourish the bond.
themes.finance: A favorable period where the pleasure of collaborating and exchanging bears fruit. Sincere joy at work attracts success.
themes.sante: Joy and inner contentment nourish health. Cultivating healthy pleasure, happy exchanges, revitalizes body and mind.
themes.spirituel: Deep joy that comes from within, serene and radiant. Joyful sharing with other sincere souls elevates and strengthens.
themes.famille: A time of joy and family closeness. Shared happy moments, warm exchanges, strengthen and delight bonds.

traits.1: Serene joy; good fortune. A calm joy without dependence, a source of true happiness.
traits.2: Sincere joy; good fortune, regret disappears. Joy founded on inner sincerity dissipates all regret.
traits.3: Joy that comes from outside; misfortune. Seeking your happiness in outside distractions and superficial pleasures disappoints.
traits.4: Joy weighed and not yet peaceful; after reflection comes joy. After choosing between higher and lower pleasures, one finds true joy.
traits.5: Sincerity toward what disintegrates; danger. Staying clear-eyed in the face of seductive but corrupting influences that quietly undermine.
traits.6: Seductive joy. Joy that only seeks to seduce and draw others in, without substance, remains hollow.

hexagrammes.image: Wind blows above water: image of dispersion. Thus the ancient kings offered sacrifices to the Lord and built temples.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Dispersion, the scattering of what had hardened and frozen — like the wind that melts ice or disperses mist. A time to untie rigidities, melt blockages, reunite what was divided. What blocked the heart dissolves; selfishness fades in favor of a broader momentum.

themes.amour: A time when rigidities and grudges dissolve. The heart's blockages melt, allowing what was divided to reunite and fluidity to return.
themes.finance: A necessary dispersal, or the dissolution of old blockages. What was frozen unties itself; it's a time to make things fluid and reorganize.
themes.sante: The dissolution of accumulated tensions and blockages. Letting tightness melt away, finding fluidity again, favors healing.
themes.spirituel: The dissolution of the rigid ego, the dispersal of illusions that separate. Opening up to a momentum larger than yourself dissolves inner barriers.
themes.famille: A time when family rigidities and misunderstandings dissolve. Hardened hearts open up, allowing what was separated to reunite.

traits.1: He brings help with the strength of a horse; good fortune. Acting quickly and vigorously to dissolve a budding misunderstanding.
traits.2: In dispersion, he runs to his support; regret disappears. At the moment of scattering, drawing closer to what sustains dissipates regrets.
traits.3: He dissolves his own self; no regret. Ridding yourself of selfishness, surpassing yourself, leaves no regret.
traits.4: He dissolves his ties with his group; supreme good fortune; dispersion leads to accumulation; something ordinary people don't think of. Detaching from narrow clans for a broader union: a rare and fruitful wisdom.
traits.5: The dispersion: great cries as in sweating; dissolving, a king remains without error. A right and strong word that gathers back together what was scattering.
traits.6: He dissolves his blood, moves away, keeps his distance, goes out; no error. Moving away from danger and from what hurts, keeping your distance, preserves from harm.

hexagrammes.image: Above the lake there is water: image of limitation. Thus the noble one creates number and measure and examines what virtue and right conduct are.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Limitation, the right measure, the boundaries that structure and give shape — like the banks that contain the lake. Just limits bring success; but a limitation that's too harsh and bitter cannot last. Wisdom lies in finding the balanced measure, neither excess nor excessive restriction.

themes.amour: The importance of fair, healthy limits in the relationship. Balanced boundaries structure and protect the bond; but excessive rigidity smothers it.
themes.finance: Discipline and measure in management. Reasonable limits bring order and security; but excessive restriction becomes counterproductive.
themes.sante: Moderation and the right measure in life habits. Healthy limits protect, but overly severe restriction is untenable and harmful.
themes.spirituel: Right discipline as the framework of inner life. Chosen limits structure the soul; but excessive, bitter asceticism dries it out.
themes.famille: Fair limits and rules harmoniously structure family life. The right measure protects, without falling into a stifling rigidity.

traits.1: Not going out of one's courtyard and enclosure; no error. Knowing how to stay within your limits at the right time, without forcing the passage.
traits.2: Not going out of the gate and courtyard; misfortune. Conversely, hesitating and staying shut in when one should act causes one to miss the opportunity.
traits.3: One who knows no limits will have to lament it; no error. The absence of measure leads to regret; acknowledging it spares one from blaming others.
traits.4: Content, accepted limitation; success. Serenely accepting fair limits, in accord with the nature of things, brings success.
traits.5: Gentle limitation; good fortune; going brings esteem. Practicing the right measure yourself with gentleness inspires and attracts respect.
traits.6: Bitter limitation; perseverance, misfortune; but regret disappears. A discipline too harsh cannot last, but acknowledging its excess avoids the worst.

hexagrammes.image: Above the lake there is wind: image of inner truth. Thus the noble one examines criminal cases to defer executions.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Inner truth, the deep sincerity of the heart that touches and transforms, even the most stubborn beings. When sincerity is total, it radiates and influences even pigs and fish. It's the force that allows one to cross the great waters: the trust born of a true heart.

themes.amour: The deep sincerity of the heart at the center of the relationship. A true, mutual trust touches and transforms; it's the most solid foundation.
themes.finance: Authentic sincerity and trust in business dealings. It's by acting from a true heart that one inspires trust and succeeds.
themes.sante: Sincerely and deeply listening to yourself, to your inner truth. Being honest with yourself about your real needs is a source of healing.
themes.spirituel: Inner truth, the absolute sincerity of the heart, is the royal path here. This deep authenticity radiates and transforms everything around it.
themes.famille: Deep sincerity at the heart of family bonds. True trust, without mask or calculation, touches hearts and lastingly unites the family.

traits.1: Being ready brings good fortune; if there are ulterior motives, one loses inner peace. Quiet sincerity is enough; hidden calculations trouble the heart.
traits.2: A crane singing in the shade, its young answers it; I have a good cup, I share it with you. The secret resonance of sincere hearts that call and answer each other from a distance.
traits.3: He finds a companion; sometimes he beats the drum, sometimes he stops, sometimes he cries, sometimes he sings. A joy dependent on another, following the ups and downs of the relationship.
traits.4: The moon nearly full; the team horse breaks free; no error. Detaching from partisan attachments to turn toward what is higher.
traits.5: He possesses the truth that binds; no error. A radiant sincerity that connects hearts and maintains union.
traits.6: The rooster's crow rising to heaven; perseverance, misfortune. Wanting fine words to rise higher than inner reality allows rings hollow.

hexagrammes.image: On the mountain, thunder: image of the preponderance of the small. Thus the noble one, in their conduct, gives preponderance to respect; in mourning, to grief; in spending, to economy.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: The preponderance of the small: a time to be content with small things and modest adjustments, not grand ambitions. Like the bird that mustn't fly too high, wisdom lies in staying humble, attentive to detail, and not aiming beyond your means.

themes.amour: A time for small attentions rather than grand gestures. Modesty, care for detail, and restraint suit better than oversized ambitions.
themes.finance: A time for economy, caution, and small steps, not great undertakings. Stay modest and attentive to detail to avoid setbacks.
themes.sante: Attention to the small adjustments of daily life rather than upheavals. Small, constant care makes all the difference here.
themes.spirituel: Humility and attention to small things are the path of the moment. Don't aim too high, but tend to the sincere detail of everyday inner life.
themes.famille: A time for small, attentive gestures and modesty. Great family ambitions are to be deferred; care for daily details comes first.

traits.1: The bird flies and meets misfortune. Wanting to rise too high too fast, beyond your measure, attracts misfortune.
traits.2: She passes her grandfather and meets her grandmother; he doesn't reach his prince and meets the official; no error. Being rightly content with what is accessible, without aiming above.
traits.3: If he isn't extremely careful, someone could strike him from behind; misfortune. Neglecting caution in a time of weakness exposes to danger.
traits.4: No error; he meets him without surpassing him; going is dangerous, one must be on guard; do not act, be constantly persevering. Staying within the right measure without forcing, while keeping your vigilance.
traits.5: Dense clouds without rain coming from the western regions; the prince shoots and hits the one in the cave. A potential not yet fully realized; acting with precision on what's within reach.
traits.6: He surpasses him without meeting him; the flying bird moves away; misfortune, it is calamity and disaster. Excess and lack of measure, going too far beyond all bounds, lead to disaster.

hexagrammes.image: Water above fire: image of the state after completion. Thus the noble one reflects on misfortune and guards against it in advance.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Completion, the finished work, the perfect order where everything is in its place. But this state of perfection is unstable: as soon as a peak is reached, decline looms. Success is present in small things, but one must remain vigilant, for after perfect order, disorder inevitably comes.

themes.amour: An accomplishment, a balance reached in the relationship. Savor this harmony while staying attentive, for every perfect balance needs tending.
themes.finance: A goal reached, an order established. But don't let your guard down: it's precisely at the peak that one must anticipate and prevent decline.
themes.sante: A balance found again, an accomplished well-being. Stay vigilant to maintain this state, for it requires constant upkeep so as not to unravel.
themes.spirituel: An inner accomplishment, an order reached. But the path never stops; staying vigilant and humble prevents falling back into disorder.
themes.famille: An accomplished family harmony, a balance reached. Savor it while staying attentive, for this precious order requires ongoing care to last.

traits.1: He brakes his wheels, he wets his tail; no error. Knowing how to hold back your momentum right after success, out of caution, avoids error.
traits.2: The woman loses the curtain of her carriage; don't run after it, in seven days you'll find it again. Not panicking over a passing loss; what is right returns in its own time.
traits.3: The great ancestor chastises the land of demons; in three years he conquers it; small men must not be employed. Great undertakings require endurance and good collaborators, not mediocre people.
traits.4: Fine clothes become rags; be careful all day long. Even in success, keeping awareness of the fragility of things and staying alert.
traits.5: The neighbor to the east who kills an ox doesn't obtain as much real blessing as the neighbor to the west with his small offering; sincerity receives the blessing. Modest sincerity is worth more than heartless splendor.
traits.6: He has his head in the water; danger. Lingering and dwelling at the end of a completed cycle, without knowing how to move on, becomes perilous.

hexagrammes.image: Fire above water: image of the state before completion. Thus the noble one is careful in distinguishing things, so that each finds its place.
hexagrammes.jugement_general: Before completion: the transition, the moment just before order is established, when everything is still in the making. The last hexagram, it doesn't close but reopens: the end of a cycle is the threshold of a new one. Success is near, but the last step must be crossed with the caution of the old fox crossing the ice.

themes.amour: A relationship in the making, on the threshold of an accomplishment still to come. Everything is possible; cross this last step with care and discernment.
themes.finance: A project close to completion but not yet realized. Success is within reach; the last step requires caution and discernment to conclude well.
themes.sante: A transition, a well-being in the making but not yet established. You're on the right track; cross the last steps with attention and patience.
themes.spirituel: The threshold of a new cycle, the eternal renewal. Nothing is ever definitively finished; every ending opens a new beginning to approach with care.
themes.famille: A family harmony under construction, close but not yet complete. Cross the last steps with care; renewal is within reach.

traits.1: He wets his tail; humiliation. Wanting to move forward too fast before being ready leads to an embarrassing setback.
traits.2: He brakes his wheels; perseverance brings good fortune. Knowing how to hold back your momentum and wait for the right moment brings success.
traits.3: Before completion, undertaking brings misfortune; beneficial to cross the great waters. The moment isn't yet ripe for decisive action, but one must prepare for the great crossing.
traits.4: Perseverance brings good fortune, regret disappears; a shock to chastise the land of demons; in three years, great rewards. A long, vigorous effort, carried out with constancy, ends up being greatly rewarded.
traits.5: Perseverance brings good fortune, no regret; the light of the noble one is true; good fortune. Clarity and sincerity at the moment of completion radiate and attract happiness.
traits.6: In full confidence one drinks wine; no error; but if one wets one's head, one loses this in truth. Sincerely celebrating success is right, but excess and immoderation spoil everything, even at the end.
